tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i glu'i dkar chag legs par bkod pa bzhugs/

na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rdo rje'i glu 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i glu ltar ma yin gyi/ 'jig rten las 'das pa thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyi don du blang ba yin zhing*/ dus ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshogs kyi dga' ston dang*/ rnal 'byor ba nyams skyong ba'i tshe len pa'o/ /dgos pa ni dad pa dang nges 'byung bskyed pa dang*/ dben par sgrub pa la brtson pa dang*/ nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba la sogs pa'o/ /len lugs ni/ len pa po rnams lus kyis rkang bro dang phyag rgya mdzes pa/ ngag gis 'dren khugs/ tshig 'bru snyan pa/ sems kyi lta dgongs dang dmigs pa gsal ba'o/ /gang las gsungs na gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rgyud dang man ngag kun nas rdo rje'i glu gsungs la/ khyad par nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud las byung zhing*/ dbang rnam par phye ba'i phra thig las/ skabs 'dir rdo rje'i glu yang blang bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang ngo sprod tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su/ rdo rje'i glu len par bshad do/ /rdo rje'i glu ji ltar blang ba'i lag len cung zad phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te/ theg pa bla na med pa'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa'o/ /rdo rje'i glu 'di la phun sum tshogs lnga ma/ bde skyid mtsho chen ma/ nor bu nyi ma ma/ 'dun pa rtse mo ma/ gzhi lam 'bras bu ma/ theg pa rim dgu ma/ gtan du legs pa ma/ o rgyan byin rlabs ma/ bdud rtsi zil mngar ma/ gtad med yongs grol ma/ mkha' 'gro 'dus pa ma/ bde skyid ri khrod ma/ mya ngan gzhi grol ma/ bar do 'phrang sgrol ma/ sbas yul rin chen ma/ 'khor ba dong sprugs ma/ bkra shis dpal 'bar ma dang bcu bdun/ lhun grub gling du gsungs pa'i skor la bzhugs so/ /༈ kun mkhyen chen po dri med 'od zer gyi snying po don gyi mgur bcu bzhugs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ chos thams cad gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa/

chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams rgya chad dang phyogs lhung med par rgyal ba thams cad kyi chos kyi sku ro gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang byung ye shes 'gag pa med par gsal ba'i dgongs pa las bzhengs te/ gnas rnam dag stug po bkod pa longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i zhing du/ rigs lnga mtshan rdzogs rdo rje 'chang gi zhing khams su bkod pa las/ thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bzhengs te gdul bya'i don tu zhing khams rnam par bkod pa'i rigs lnga gang chen mtsho so sor snang ba las/ shar phyogs su mi bskyod pa gang chen mtsho'i phyag mthil na/ rdo rje rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing*/ ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gang chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gang chen mtsho brten pa dang*/ lho phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan gang chen mtsho'i phyag mthil na/ rin chen rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gang chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gang chen mtsho brten pa dang*/ nub phyogs su snang ba mtha' yas gang chen mtsho'i phyag mthil na/ pad+ma rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gang chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gang chen mtsho brten pa dang*/ byang phyogs su don yod grub pa gang chen mtsho'i phyag mthil na/ rgya gram rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las spos chu'i rgyun gang chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gang chen mtsho brten pa dang*/ dbus phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho'i phyag mthil pad+ma'i steng na/ 'khor lo rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gang chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gang chen mtsho brten pa thams cad la gdul bya sems can gyi rigs khams gsum rigs drug 'khor ba'i chos so cog rang snang ba so so'i ngo kha la/

'dul byed rgyal ba'i sprul sku gang la gang 'dul ba dpag tu med pas chos kyi sgo dang*/ theg pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pas/ 'gro ba rnams mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phrin las dpag tu med pa mdzad pa las khyad par du rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing khams gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa 'khor lo rnam par brtsegs pa las/ bcu gsum pa thugs ka dpal gyi be'u la brten pa'i 'jig rten gyi zhing khams mi mjed ces bya ba gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bye ba phrag brgyad cus bkod pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bskal pa bzang po rdo rje 'chang dang thub pa sprul pa'i sku stong gi gdul zhing so sor sku bye ba phrag brgyar sprul nas/ snga phyir gshegs shing da ltar bzhugs pas chos kyi sgo dang theg pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa las/ khyad par gling bzhi bar ma'i 'jig rten mi mjed lho 'dzam bu gling gi tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su/ dpal kun tu bzang po rdo rjer 'chang gi skur bzhengs te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ de nyid thun mong gi gdul bya la shākya thub pa'i skur bzhengs te/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas zhi ba'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su/ phyi nang gi bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad de/ de dag gi don blo dman pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya ba'i ched du/ rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa so so'i don phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sprul nas sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi theg pa so so'i don 'grel par mdzad pa'i pan+ṭi ta dang*/ rgyan drug mchog brgyad la sogs dpag tu med pa dang*/ grub chen brgyad cu la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i tshogs su sprul te 'phags pa'i yul du chos kyi sgron me snang bar mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sprul par bshad de/

rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyed la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid du sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa dpag tu med pa snga phyir sems can gyi don la byon pa thams cad kyi bka'i dgongs pa dpag tu med pa bkral zhing*/ don gyi snying po phyogs gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa las/ rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā phan chad du grub thob brgyad cu la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpag tu med pa byon pa rnams kyis gdul bya'i don du/ phyi nang gi nges pa don gyi snying po rdo rje'i mgur la sogs pa dpag tu med pa bzhengs shing*/ khyad par du mnga' ris bod kyi yul/ gangs kyi ri bo'i 'gram/ rigs gsum mgon po'i gdul zhing me tog ku mu da kha rgyas pa lta bu'i khrod 'di nyid du bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul pa yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa dpag tu med pa snga phyir gshegs shing byon pa rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don la chos kyi sgo dang theg pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa gsungs shing*/ khyad par du bstan pa snga dar gyi dus na bsam yas mchims phur grub chen nyi shu rtsa lnga/ lha ri yer par grub chen brgya rtsa/ lho brag mkhar chur nyi shu rtsa gcigadapal chen chu bo rir sum cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa byon pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang mgur bzhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ bstan pa bar dar dang phyi dar gyi dus su yang bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don la grub pa brnyes pa du ma byon shing*/ rdo rje'i glu dang mgur du bzhengs pa tshad med pa la de dag gi nang nas phul du gyur pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mar pa mi la dang*/ dwags po gling ras pa dang*/ 'khrul zhig rdza ri pa dang*/

grub chen me long rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyis ri khrod phyogs med du 'grim/ sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ dka' spyad dang du blangs/ chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bas rang don rtogs pa'i mgur bzhengs pa dang*/ khyad par du tshe gcig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod pa rnams dang*/ snying po nges don nyams su len par 'dod pa rnams dang*/ thar pa dam pa'i rigs la gnas pa rnams zhi ba'i chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ gzhan don rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa la mtha' yas pa las/ de la da res kyi skabs su chos nyid kyi dgongs pa la bar mtshams med pa rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams zhes bya ba de nyid kyis phyi rabs kyi don du rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur/ rnal 'byor rig pa'i gsal 'debs/ lta bsgom spyod 'bras kyi mgur/ nyams rtogs gong du 'byin pa bogs 'byin rdo rje'i mgur/ tshig don spros pa gcod pa grub mtha' shan 'byed kyi mgur/ nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed pa mi rtag 'chi ba rjes dran gyi mgur/ dge sdig blang dor 'byed pa las rgyu 'bras kyi mgur la sogs pa dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs pa las/ khyad par da res kyi skabs su rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug de nyid kyis/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa dbu ru lha sa dang nye ba'i gnas/ brag ri rin chen brtsegs pa'i 'dabs/ lhun grub gling zhes bya ba'i dben gnas su/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa skal bzang gi rnal 'byor pho mo du ma la/ chos phun sum tshogs pa theg pa bla na med pa'i yang rtse bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i 'khor lo bskor ba na/ dus phun sum tshogs pa yar ngo'i tshes bcu mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshe gsol 'debs mgur du bzhengs pa'i skor snyan du 'bul bas gsan par zhu 'tshal/ zhes pa la sogs pa mgur dbyangs kyi sngon du skabs dang sbyar la mtshams sbyar ro/

/dkar chag chen mo zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas bla ma rje/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha/ /byin rlabs mchog stsol mkha' 'gro ma/ /mi 'bral spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /lus ngag yid gsum rab dngas bas/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /thugs rjes dgongs shing byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid snod bcud zhing khams na/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /mtha' yas rab 'byams kun gyis mchod/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rdzogs par gsol/ /ma rig nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chags nyes ltung kun/ /sgyu ma tsam du bshags par bgyi/ /'khor ba'i bag chags sbyang du gsol/ /rang gzhan kun gyis dus kun tu/ /bsags pa'i dge ba rgya mtsho la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /dge tshogs gong 'phel mdzad du gsol/ /'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /theg pa sna tshogs chos kyi sgo/ /dpag med 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /rtag tu chos dang mi 'bral gsol/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stongs par/ /mtha' yas sems can don gyi phyir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol/ /don gnyis rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba yis/ /'gro drug thar pa'i lam zhugs te/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar shog /byang chub rgya mtsho mtha' yas shog /'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra/ /da res thugs rje'i gru chen gyis/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar shog /'khrul snang las la zin pa med/ /don chung byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /da res thugs rje'i phyag brkyangs te/ /thar lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ /zhi ba myang 'das thar pa'i gling*/ /ded dpon rin chen rnyed pa 'dra/ /da res gnas lugs gdod ma'i ngang*/

/btsan sa zin par mdzad du gsol/ /gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas bla ma rje/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /gnas lugs don gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /skye shi med pa'i don rtogs shog /byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung bar shog /sna tshogs snang ba'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /gzhi med gsal ba'i tshom bu bkod/ /stong pa chos sku'i ngang du bzhes/ /skye shi med pa'i don rtogs shog /grags pa sgra yi maṇ+ḍal la/ /rang yal rjes med kyi tshom bu bkod/ /grags stong gsung gi ngang du bzhes/ /tshangs dbyangs chos kyi don rtogs shog /dran rig sems kyi maṇ+ḍal la/ /shar grol 'dzin med kyi tshom bu bkod/ /rig stong thugs kyi ngang du bzhes/ /mi rtogs ye shes don rtogs shog /rang byung rig pa'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /zang thal rjen pa'i tshom bu bkod/ /chos zad blo 'das kyi ngang du bzhes/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don rtogs shog /ye stong rig pa'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /rgya chad phyogs bral gyi tshom bu bkod/ /bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang du bzhes/ /gnas lugs lta ba'i don rtogs shog /rang gsal rig pa'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /ma spangs rang gnas kyi tshom bu bkod/ /bang dwangs 'od gsal gyi ngang du bzhes/ /rang byung sgom pa'i don rtogs shog /ma 'gag rig pa'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /snang sems sgyu ma'i tshom bu bkod/ /blang dor gnyis med kyi ngang du bzhes/ /zhen med spyod pa'i don rtogs shog /ka dag chos zad kyi maṇ+ḍal la/ /blo bral zang ka'i tshom bu bkod/ /gnas lugs rang mal gyi ngang du bzhes/ /mthar phyin 'bras bu'i don rtogs shog /ngo bo stong pa'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /bsam dang bral ba'i tshom bu bkod/ /blo las 'das pa'i ngang du bzhes/ /chos sku rgyal po'i don rtogs shog /rang bzhin gsal ba'i maṇ+ḍal la/ / lhun grub rang snang gi tshom bu la/

/rang byung 'od gsal gyi ngang du bzhes/ /longs sku gzhir snang gi don rtogs shog /thugs rje 'gags med kyi maṇ+ḍal la/ /'char tshul sna tshogs kyi tshom bu bkod/ /rang byung rgyan gyi ngang du bzhes/ /sprul sku kun khyab kyi don rtogs shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /don gyi maṇ+ḍal 'di phul bas/ /'gro kun tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ /phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /gnas lugs don gyi maṇ+ḍal rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su mgur du bzhengs pa'o/ /dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bla ma rje/ /kun tu bzang dang dbyer med pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /phyogs gang du phyin kyang bla ma dran/ /gnas gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran/ /dus nyin mtshan 'khor mar bla ma dran/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dus na ning bzhugs kyang da lo med/ /bsam zhing bsam zhing bla ma dran/ /gdung sems mos gus rgyun chad med/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /rkyen ci 'dra shar yang bla ma dran/ /brda ji ltar mthong yang bla ma dran/ /chos gang la bsam kyang bla ma dran/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /shar ri bdun gangs ri'i rtse mthong bas/ /pha bla ma dran nas mchi ma shor/ /sems gdung bas skyo nas dran pa 'khrul/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /steng sprin dkar mthong nas dbyings su yal/ /des kyang rje btsun bla ma dran/ /khong mgon du byon nas mya ngan 'das/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' dag pa mthong nas bla ma dran/ /dbyings chos kyi sku yi dgongs pa la/ /dus 'pho 'gyur med par rtag tu bzhugs/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dbyings zad khar mthong nas bla ma dran/ /gzhi dag pa chos sku'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /lhun grub gzugs sku'i snang ba ston/

/gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /steng nyi zla bsam nas bla ma dran/ /thugs rje'i 'od la phyogs ris med/ /skal ldan me tog pad+ma'i gnyen/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /dus rtag tu bsten yang skad cig tsam/ /chos mang du thos kyang skad cig tsam/ /pha da dung thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan thos pa tsam gyis 'khor ba zhig

/zhal mthong ba tsam gyis mos pa skye/ /gsung thos pa tsam gyis tsam sna zin/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /mgon khyod dang mjal ba'i skal ldan rnams/ /'khor ba'i 'phrang las thar pa lags/ /bde chen gling du phyin pa lags/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /khyed kyi rjes zhugs gdul bya rnams/ /tshe 'dir yang bde la de'i phyi bde/ /gtan gyi bde chen gling du bde/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' drin dran pa ma zhes bya ba'i gsol 'debs rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling du mdzad pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /shes byed mkhyen pa'i rta bdun dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mkhyen brtse'i skal ldan snying gi pad+mo 'byed/ /dpal mgon bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /kye gson dang skal ldan grogs po dag /phan pa'i snying gtam sha tsha'i gros 'debs shig /snying nas yod kyi 'di bzhin dang du longs/ /snying gtam lags pas snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /khyed kyis sngon bsags dge ba'i 'phro yod pas/ /tshe 'dir rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rin chen thob/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chos dang mjal dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig byed re ran/ /dal 'byor 'di ni thob dka' brgya lam tsam/ /de bas chos dang 'phrad pa nyin skar bzhin/ /theg mchog chos dang mjal ba srid mtha' tsam/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig mdzad re ran/ /da lta dal 'byor rnyed cing rang dbang thob/ /so thar byang sems bla na med pa yi/ /sdom gsum rang gi rgyud la tshang dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig byed re ran/ /bla ma mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs dngos dang mjal/ /theg chen bla med dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs/ /sangs rgyas lag pa'i mthil du bzhag dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig mdzad re ran/ /dpal mgon bla mas skal ldan gdul bya la/

/zab mo'i gdams pa thugs kyi yang zhun te/ /gang 'dod rnams la ci 'dod sbyin dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig byed re ran/ /rang gi sems nyid skye ba med pa'i don/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon du bstan pa'i tshe/ /rang gis cha shas tsam zhig go dus 'dir/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig mdzad re ran/ /ji ltar bstan pa'i rang rig chos kyi sku/ /ji bzhin ngang la skyong du yod ring 'dir/ /nam bzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma sgrub na legs/ /snying nas dam pa'i chos shig byed re ran/ /kye ma khams gsum gang du skyes na yang*/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i gnas skabs cung zad med/ /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dag la spyod dgos pas/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /gnyen bshes tshogs rnams ji ltar mang na yang*/ /mi rtag glo bur 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /yid la phreng yang skad cig sdod dbang med/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /nor rdzas 'byor pa ji ltar che ba bzhin/ /ser sna la sogs nyon mongs kun gyi gzhi/ /'chi ba'i tshe na sems chags 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /dmag dpung srid sde ji ltar 'dzom na yang*/ /yun du mi gnas so sor 'bral ba'i chos/ /thams cad mi rtag 'jig rten pha rol 'gro/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /dbang dang pho chus ji ltar che na yang*/ /mi dge nyon mongs sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhi/ /mnar med la sogs ngan song gsum gyi rgyu/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /rang bas rgan dang gzhon pa mang po shi /mnyam pa'ang 'chi ste rang yang 'chi bar nges/ /shi nas gar skye rang dbang mi bdog pas/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /mdor na tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad kun/ kha zas bzang la btsan dug 'dres pa bzhin/ /snying nas spong ba dam pa'i rnam thar lags/ /nges par byang chub sgrub pa'i dus la babs/

/kye ma kyi hud khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos/ /mi rtag mi brtan sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas/ /shi ba'i tshe na gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu/ /'chi dus phan pa'i chos zhig rang la 'tshal/ /tshe 'di mi rtag yud tsam skar mda' bzhin/ /lang tsho mi rtag ston ka'i me tog 'dra/ /rang dbang med par pha rol 'gro dgos pas/ /'chi dus phan pa'i chos zhig rang la 'tshal/ /da lta'i dus na le los g.yengs ba dang*/ /snyom las ngang la mi tshe 'das pa na/ /las kyi dbang gis gar skye cha med do/ /'chi dus phan pa'i chos shig rang la 'tshal/ /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol 'gro ba'i tshe/ /gnyen bshes nor rdzas ci yod shul du lus/ /rang gi lus 'di dor nas 'gro dgos pas/ /'chi dus phan pa'i chos shig rang la 'tshal/ /glo bur nyid du 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gdeng dang mi ldan na/ /zang zing mang pos phan par cang gda' 'am/ /'chi dus phan pa'i chos shig rang la 'tshal/ /da lta nyid du 'chi bar gyur pa na/ /'jigs pa med pa'i gdeng zhig nges par 'tshal/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i dge 'bras ci yod soms/ /'chi dus phan pa'i chos shig rang la 'tshal/ /de bas skal ldan sprang po'i gros la gson/ /rang dbang yod ring byang chub mi bsgrubs na/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus par mi 'gyur ram/ /'chi dus phan pa'i chos shig rang la 'tshal/ /e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid 'di/ /brtags shing dpyad na snying po cung zad med/ /cis kyang dgos med thams cad 'ching ba'i chos/ /nges 'byung skyo shes nges par gces so aṃ/ /theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la/ /bdag gzhan bde sdug brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /snying nas skyes pa nges par gces so ang*/ /rang nyid yi dam lha ru gsal ba yi/ /spyi bor bla ma yid bzhin nor bu bsgom/ /rtse gcig yid kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshe/ /mos gus gdung shugs nges par gces so ang*/

/kun gzhi tshogs brgyad gzung 'dzin gnyis la sogs/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun/ /ye stong rtsa bral dngos med zang thal du/ /gting nas rtogs pa nges par gces so ang*/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang rig chos kyi sku/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes mngon sum du/ /rjen par rtogs pa nges par gces so ang*/ /lam mchog khregs chod thod rgal rnam pa gnyis/ /ched 'dzin med par dbyer med zung 'jug cing*/ /ji bzhin spros pa bral bar rang babs su/ /yin lugs skyong ba nges par gces so ang*/ /phan pa'i snying gtam kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o// dge'o// ༈ rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul bla ma rje/ /'dod 'byung nor bu rin po cher/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rjes byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /'khor ba rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra/ /'khrul snang sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /da res bde chen byang chub gling*/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma byas na legs/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam 'dra/ /zang zing 'khrul pas rig pa bslu/ /da res ma 'khrul dam pa'i chos/ /bslu med btsan sa bzung na legs/ /rnam g.yengs tshong dus ltad mo 'dra/ /'du 'dzi'i ngang la mi tshe zad/ /da res thar lam snying po la/ /don chen byang chub sgrub na legs/ / 'khrul snang byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /gzung 'dzin snang bas rang sems bslu/ /da res sgo gsum zab mo'i chos/ /gnas lugs ngang la brtson na legs/ /'chi bdag nub kha'i grib ma 'dra/ /skad cig mi sdod tshur tshur 'ong*/ /da res 'chi med gnyug ma'i don/ /bde chen btsan sa bzung na legs/ /gnyen bshes tshong kha'i mgron po 'dra/ /da lta 'dus kyang tha ma 'bral/ /da res 'bral med snying po'i don/ /sems nyid rang so bltas na legs/ /mdza' bshes lcang kha'i bye'u chung 'dra/ /mthun par 'grogs kyang so sor 'bral/

/da res mi 'bral chos sku la/ /gnas lugs btsan sa bzung na legs/ /'khor g.yog nyin gcig gla mi 'dra/ /lhan cig 'khor kyang myur du 'bral/ /da res mi 'gyur chos sku la/ /dgongs pa zad sar bskyal na legs/ /snyan grags nam mkha'i 'brug dang 'dra/ /dar gcig grags pas rang sems bslu/ /da res yin lugs gnyug ma'i don/ /'od gsal chos nyid bsgom na legs/ /nor rdzas bung ba'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyod/ /da res zas nor longs spyod kun/ / sbyin pa'i gter du sbas na legs/ /lus ngag ma zhi smyon pa 'dra/ /bag med nyon mongs rang gar 'chor/ /da res sgo gsum rab dul bas/ /tshul khrims rgyan dang ldan na legs/ /gdug sems nags kyi me chen 'dra/ /rang rgyud dge ba'i bud shing bsregs/ /da res bzod pa'i go gyon la/ /khong khro'i zug rngu phyung na legs/ /snyom las ma he'i gnyid dang 'dra/ /byas pa'i las la grub dus med/ /da res brtson 'grus lcags brabs la/ /rig pa'i rta mchog bskul na legs/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang mig 'phrul 'dra/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis nyin mtshan bslu/ /da res bsam gtan don bsgom nas/ /gcig pur dben par gnas na legs/ /gti mug mtshan mo'i mun pa 'dra/ /chos dang chos min gzugs mi mthong*/ /da res shes rab sgron me yis/ /phyogs med thos bsam byas na legs/ /brel do chu yi gnyer ma 'dra/ /bya byed las la zin pa med/ /da res tshe 'di'i bya ba kun/ /cog bzhag rgyab tu bskyur na legs/ /yod kyin je dgos phyug po 'dra/ /ji ltar 'byor yang chog shes med/ /da res sgyu ma'i nor rdzas la/ /ma zhen 'dzin pa btang na legs/ / bdag 'dzin 'ching ba'i zhags pa 'dra/ /nga bdag 'khor ba'i btson rar 'ching*/ /da res gang la'ang ma chags pas/ /snang ba chos skur bsgyur na legs/ /mtshan ldan nor bu rin chen 'dra/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid char du 'bebs/

/da res bla ma dam pa la/ /brten nas dam chos sgrub na legs/ / shes bya nam mkha'i gza' skar 'dra/ /bslab dgos gnas la zad pa med/ / da res chos sku snying po'i don/ /zab mo'i de nyid bsgom na legs/ /tha snyad ne tso'i 'don pa 'dra/ /chos dang rang rgyud 'dzol ba mang*/ /da res gang shes nyams len gyis/ /rang rgyud nyon mongs btul na legs/ /grub mtha' srin gyi kha chu 'dra/ /rang rgyud rang gis 'ching ba la/ /da res mtha' bral chos nyid don/ /khas len 'dzin pa med na legs/ /lta sgom long ba'i kha bshad 'dra/ /gleng ba mang ste thebs pa nyung*/ /da res sems nyid chos sku'i don/ / yin min blo las 'das na legs/ /drod rtags byis pa'i kha zas 'dra/ /cung zad re la chags pa la/ /da res nyams rtogs ci skyes kyang*/ /mi myong zhen pa bral na legs/ /sgrub 'dod khe bsog tshong pa 'dra/ /phyi dus yid smon re ba mang*/ /da res mthar thug chos sku'i don/ /rang chas lhun grub rtogs na legs/ /'khor 'das rmi lam bzang ngan 'dra/ /rang snang gzhi med stong pa'i gzugs/ /da res blang dor gnyis med pas/ /rig pa rang sa bzung na legs/ /chos brgyad nad pa'i sngas dang 'dra/ /ji ltar byas kyang bde ba med/ /da res tshe 'di blos btang la/ /ming gzugs phung po bshig na legs/ /re 'dod khyi rgan lam zan 'dra/ /'dod pa'i don dang 'dzol ba mang*/ /da res 'dod blo gzhig byas la/ /gang byung 'dun ma brten na legs/ /bya rtsol byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /byas pas mi zin bzhag na zin/ /da res byar med chos sku'i ngang*/ /dgongs pa zad sar bskyal na legs/ /dpe don 'dus pa rdo rje'i mgur/ /drang don nges don 'dzom pa 'di/ /dad ldan rnams kyi snyan du 'bul/ /dge bas 'khor ba dong sprug shog /dpe don nges don rdo rje'i mgur theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis dad ldan rnams kyi don du lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su mdzad pa dge'o//

༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rtogs pa chos nyid rgya mtsho'i klong*/ /mi 'gyur nam mkha'i dbyings rum 'dra/ /mtha' dbus med par khyab brdal le/ /dgongs pa blo las 'das pa lags/ /cir snang rang byung rig pa'i ngang*/ /snang stong gzhi med rtsa ba bral/ /ma 'gag snang ba zang thal le/ /yul snang med pa gsal snang lags/ /gang shar ris med stong pa'i ngang*/ /rang yal ris med gzhi rtsa bral/ /shar grol rig pa phyam brdal le/ /gzung 'dzin ye stong rtsa bral lags/ /rang byung ye shes chos nyid dang*/ /gzung 'dzin ris med mkha' ltar dag /rgya grol chos skur rjen khres se/ /blo bral rdzogs pa chen po lags/ /rang byung ka nas dag pa'i gzhi/ /ma bgrod ye nas nye ba'i lam/ /ma bsgrubs lhun gyis grub pa'i 'bras/ /'od gsal chos skur rdzogs pa lags/ /khyab brdal chos nyid gdod ma'i klong*/ /'khor 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /rgyu 'bras rtsol sgrub 'das pa'i mgur/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos blangs/ /gnyug ma rdo rje'i mgur zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su mdzad pa dge'o/ / ༈ mkha' ltar dag pa'i dpal mgon chos kyi rje/ /chos nyid rtogs pas 'khor 'das gzhi nas grol/ /kun tu bzang dang thugs dgongs dbyer med pa'i/ /mtshungs med 'gro mgon bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rig pa'i ngang la 'khor 'das dbyer med pas/ /gzhi nas ma skyes chos zad blo 'das dang*/ /gzung 'dzin yul med chos nyid rig pa'i 'gros/ /bar med phyal ba rjen par zang thal le/ /gang snang thams cad gzhi med stong pa'i gzugs/ /med la gsal snang sgyu ma chu zla 'dra/ /snang la bden med gzhi la yod ma myong*/ /yul med stong pa rjen par zang thal le/ /gang shar ris med rang gsal stong pa'i ngang*/ /dran rtogs rjes med stong yal nam mkha' 'dra/ /sems dang sems byung gzhi rtsa dngos po med/

/'dzin pa'i yul med stong par zang thal le/ / snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das ci snang yang*/ /stong pa zang ka ma bcos gdod ma'i ngang*/ /gzhi med rten med rang byung rig pa'i ngang*/ /'char tshul ma 'gag snang bar zang thal le/ /rang gsal 'dzin med chos dbyings rig pa'i 'gros/ /rgya yan yongs grol rgyal ba'i dgongs pa la/ /sna tshogs chos kun ye nas rnam dag pas/ /gnyug ma blo bral rjen par zang thal le/ /ji ltar 'char yang de ltar mi 'dzin pas/ /gang ltar snang yang de ltar mi rtog par/ /spros bsdu med par rang grol rig pa'i ngang*/ /rang bab phyal ba rjen par zang thal le/ /phyi ru mi spro nang du mi bsdu la/ /yid la mi byed dmigs gtad blo las 'das/ /sgom dang mi bsgom bsam las 'das pa'i ngang*/ / rang byung ye shes rjen par zang thal le/ /thun mtshams bar med rgya yan rig pa'i 'gros/ /rang gsal rjen pa dmigs gtad kun dang bral/ /phyi nang yul med chos dbyings gdod ma'i ngang*/ /bar med rig pa chos skur zang thal le/ /ye nas lhun grub rgyal ba'i dgongs pa la/ /gzhi nas ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang*/ /rgyu 'bras blang dor 'khor 'das gnyis med par/ /'od gsal rig pa longs skur zang thal le/ /ma yengs mi gnas dri med rig pa la/ /gar yang ma grub cir yang ma 'gags par/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung yod med 'das pa'i ngang*/ /'char gzhi ma 'gags sprul skur zang thal le/ /'khor bar snang yang gzhi med stong pa'i gzugs/ /rang bzhin 'khrul snang gdod nas yod ma myong*/ /spang du med pa sgyu ma'i gsal snang 'di/ /'khor ba dong sprug dgongs pa zang thal la/ /rang snang 'chal tshul cir yang ma 'gags pas/ /sku dang ye shes dag pa'i zhing la sogs/ / ji ltar snang yang gzhi med stong pa'i gzugs/ /'khor 'das ming med stong par zang thal le/ /rigs pa'i ngang na bzang ngan ci snang yang*/ /stong gsal ma 'gags rang snang rol ba tsam/ /gzhan du ma g.yos rang du ma grub la/

/ gnyis med rang snang rig pa zang thal le/ /snang brtag chos rnams blos btags 'khrul ba la/ /gang du ma grub phyi nang yul med ngang*/ /rang byung ye shes spros pa'i mtha' las 'das/ /chos zad ngang du blo zad zang thal le/ / 'khor rung 'das rung snang rung srid kyang rung*/ /gzung rung 'dzin rung thams cad gzhi rtsa bral/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po ru/ /ye nas sangs rgyas chos skur zang thal le/ /spang blang med pa byang chub chen po'i dbyings/ / 'gyur ba med pa rang byung rig pa'i klong*/ /blo las 'das pa rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /kun byed rig pa chos kun zang thal le/ /ma bsam ma dpyad gdal ba chen po'i gzhi/ /dbyings las ma g.yos chos sku rang mal lam/ / rang rig dri med mngon gyur 'bras bu'i ngang*/ /rang byung rig pa 'gyur med zang thal le/ /bya rtsol bral ba'i chos sku'i mkha' dbyings la/ /rang byung rig pa rtogs pa'i rtsal chen gyis/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i g.yang sa rab bcad

de/ /rig pa'i khyung chen gdod mar zang thal le/ /rtsal chen rdzogs pa chos nyid rdo rje'i sku/ /theg pa'i yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /ji bzhin mngon gyur klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /khams gsum yongs grol mi nub rgyal mtshan bslangs/ /ma lus 'gro kun 'bad med yongs grol te/ /kun bzang chos skur lhun gyis grub par shog /rdzogs pa chen po don gyi dbyings/ khyung chen rdo rje'i mgur/ slob dpon rin chen shes rab kyi don du lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su mdzad pa rdzogs so// //nam mkha' mtha' dbus ma zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis sbyar ba'o/ / ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bla ma grub chen rnams kyis gsungs pa'i mgur la dpag tu med pa las/ da res kyi 'di nyid rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling gi gnas mchog tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe der tshogs pa'i skal ldan rnams la/ sngon gyi grub thob gong mas dngos grub brnyes tshul dang*/ rlung sems dag pa'i rten 'brel 'grig tshul gleng pa na/ kha cig gis bla ma rin po che/ de lta bu'i tshul de rnams nyung la don 'dus pa zhig gsung par zhu zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ gsang sngags bla na med pa'i nye lam rdo rje lus kyi pho brang du rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi rten 'brel 'grig tshul mgur du bzhengs pa/ rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med cing*/ /yon tan yid bzhin dngos grub gter/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i pho brang du/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi gnas/ /rlung sems dag pa'i 'phro 'du yis/ /legs pa'i rten 'brel nang du 'grig /rang byung 'od gsal byang chub sems/ /rlung sems dag pa nyi zla'i 'gros/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor rab chud pas/ /gzhan don phrin las tshul du snang*/ /mnyam rdzogs rang rig 'od gsal mchog

/chos kyi 'khor lo rab chud pas/ /gzung 'dzin blo yi spros kun zhi/ /mi rtog chos sku'i tshul du snang*/ /rang byung ngang dwangs byang chub sems/ /rlung sems longs spyod 'khor lor chud/ /rdo rje'i glu yi mtsho rdol zhing*/ /'dod yon rang rdzogs longs skur snang*/ /rnam dag rang byung byang chub sems/ /rlung sems bde chen 'khor lor chud/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes ngang*/ /ngo bo nyid sku'i tshul du snang*/ /rang byung 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su/ /rlung sems dwangs ma'i 'phro 'du yis/ /'dod rgu nang nas 'char ba 'di/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam lags/ /ye shes mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /skal ldan skye bo'i tshogs la 'bul/ /dge bas khams gsum 'gro ba kun/ /bde chen byang chub thob par shog /rtsa rlung rdo rje'i mgur zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis slob dpon rin chen shes rab la gsungs pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ chos rje bla ma de nyid bde chen lhun grub gling gi dben gnas na bzhugs pa'i tshes brgyad cig gi dus su/ bla ma gong ma'i mdzad spyod dang bka' drin dran zhing*/ rang gzhan gyi snang ba la skyo shas drag po skyes nas dgos med don gyi mgur 'di skal ldan rnams la gsung pa/ gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che/ /thugs rje dgongs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'di dang phyi ma bar do'i dus kun tu/ /mgon med bdag gi skyabs dang dpung gnyen mdzod/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i gnas la brten brten nas/ /chos nyid don gyi dgongs pa'i sa zin med/ /gnas lugs rig pa'i gtan yul ma zin na/ /yul mkhar khyim gyis bdag la dgos pa med/ /nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i grogs la chags chags nas/ / gnyug ma lhan cig skye pa'i ye shes ring*/ /'du 'bral med pa'i grogs dang ma 'grogs na/ /bza' tshang 'khrul pas bdag la dgos pa med/ /lan chags bu tsha'i gnyer ka byed byed nas/

/rang byung ye shes rig pa'i rang mdangs stor/ /sems nyid 'od gsal khye'u chung mi ldan na/ /lan chags bu tshas bdag la dgos pa med/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun 'khor la chags chags nas/ /rang chas yon tan yid bzhin dpung gnyen stor/ /'bral med ye shes 'khor dang mi ldan na/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bdag la dgos pa med/ /longs spyod 'byor bde phun tshogs gnyer gnyer nas/ /ye nas lhun grub rig pa'i dga' bde stor/ /nyams rtogs ting 'dzin longs spyod mi ldan na/ /tshe 'di'i longs spyod bdag la dgos pa med/ /'khrul snang sgyu ma'i nor la zhen zhen nas/ /sems nyid 'od gsal yid bzhin nor bu stor/ / chog shes 'phags pa'i nor dang mi ldan na/ /longs spyod zang zing bdag la dgos pa med/ /ming dang gzugs kyi pho bzo byed byed nas/ /sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub thob dus med/ /snying nas brtson pas dam chos ma bsgrubs na/ /phun sum tshogs los bdag la dgos pa med/ /rnam g.yeng 'khrul bas nyin mtshan 'da' 'da' nas/ /lta sgom rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad thob dus med/ /gong ma rnams kyi rjes su ma snyogs na/ /'dod yon 'du 'dzi'i bdag la dgos pa med/ /rnyed bkur snyan grags ro la chags chags nas/ /'jig rten chos brgyad 'di dang 'bral dus med/ /zhen chags 'khrul pa mkha' ltar ma dag na/ /bla ma bzang los bdag la dgos pa med/ /tshe 'di'i mdzes chos gzhan snang bsgyur bsgyur nas/ /rang snang bslu med btsan sa zin dus med/ /snying nas dgos med rgyud la ma skyes na/ /ngo mtshar che los bdag la dgos pa med/ /rang don shor ba'i gzhan don byed byed nas/ /rang dbang bde dal dam chos 'grub dus med/ /dus ngan 'khor slob brten 'dris ma spangs na/ /gzhan phan che los bdag la dgos pa med/ /don med 'khrul pa'i bya bar bstun bstun nas/ /rang snang gnyis med ye shes brtan dus med/ /mthun 'jug rtsig pa rming nas ma 'gyel na/

/ngo srung sems 'dzin bdag la dgos pa med/ /nyin mtshan tshe 'di'i bya bas g.yeng g.yeng nas/ / byar med chos nyid gtan srid zin dus med/ /bya byed 'khrul pa cog gis ma bzhag na/ /don med bya bas bdag la dgos pa med/ /du ma 'dus pa'i gnas la brten brten nas/ /gcig pur dben pa'i dam chos 'grub dus med/ /mi med lung stong 'grim par ma byas na/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas kyi bdag la dgos pa med/ /'di dang 'dres pa'i dge sbyor byed byed nas/ /gtan gyi lam sna da res zin dus med/ /tshe 'di'i mdzes chos snying nas ma spangs na/ / dge sbyor bzang los bdag la dgos pa med/ /dmigs bcas lta bsgom chos la zhen zhen nas/ /chos nyid rig pa'i gnam 'phang gcod dus med/ / blos byas gzung 'dzin zhen pa ma dag na/ /drod rtags phra mos bdag la dgos pa med/ /rim rtsol blo yi chos la brten brten nas/ /blo bral don gyi dgongs pa rtogs dus med/ /rdzogs chen snying thig don la ma bsgoms na/ / mthar 'dzin chos kyi bdag la dgos pa med/ /e ma dad ldan thar pa 'dod pa dag /gsang chen bla med don la rab zhugs te/ /gcig pur dben par sgrub pa snying por mdzod/ /tshe 'dir chos sku'i gtan srid zin pa lags/ /glu 'di theg pa'i rgyal po rnal 'byor pa/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos legs par blangs/ /dge ba de yis ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /'bad med yongs grol kun tu bzang por shog /dgos med don gyi rdo rje'i mgur/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su bzhengs pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rgyal sras chos rje de nyid kyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su dgun bzhugs mdzad nas thon pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rnal 'byor rnams 'dus te/ so sos nyams len byas lugs gleng ba na/ gol sa gcod cing bogs 'byin dang rtsal sbyong ba'i gnad 'gag gcig tu dril ba gnad du brdeg pa cig mgur du gsung bar zhu zhus pa na/

chos rje bla mas yang gsang bla na med pa'i rang gnad mgur du bzhengs pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi yang mes po/ /gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*/ /bla ma yin dam mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i don/ /rig stong zang thal chos kyi sku/ /rang gsal rjen pa ma gtogs pa/ /sems 'dzin bsgom pas mi bslad 'tshal/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i don/ /rang snang 'od gsal longs sku 'di/ /gsal stong 'dzin med ma gtogs pa/ /dga' brod zhen pas mi 'ching 'tshal/ /thugs rje kun la khyab pa'i don/ /ma 'gags rang shar sprul sku 'di/ /shar grol rjen pa ma gtogs pa/ /skye 'gags grangs su mi gdab 'tshal/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i don/ /ngo sprod thabs cha tha dad 'di/ /don la dbyings gcig ma gtogs pa/ /tha dad gzhan du mi bzung 'tshal/ /ngo bo bskyang yang rang bzhin don/ /thugs rje mi 'gag 'char tshul 'di/ /zang thal rig pa ma gtogs pa/ /stong chad had por ma song 'tshal/ /rang bzhin bskyang yang ngo bo'i don/ /thugs rje 'gag med shar grol 'di/ /stong gsal 'dzin med ma gtogs pa/ /rtag 'dzin zhen par ma song 'tshal/ /thugs rje bskyang yang ngo bo'i don/ /rang bzhin lhun grub rig gdangs 'di/ /ye stong rtsa bral ma gtogs pa/ /rnam rtog nying 'khrul ma song 'tshal/ /ngo bo'i dus na zang thal don/ /lhun grub thugs rje rang chas 'di/ /rig stong 'jog pa ma gtogs pa/ /snang sems spang blo mi bskyed 'tshal/ /rang bzhin dus na 'od gsal don/ /ngo bo thugs rje rang chas 'di/ /rang gdangs lta ba ma gtogs pa/ /stong sems spong blo mi bskyed 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i dus na shar grol don/ /zad sar skyel ba ma gtogs pa/ /stong gsal spong blo mi bskyed 'tshal/ /ji ltar bsgoms kyang rig pa'i don/ /stong gsal ma 'gags 'char tshul 'di/ /ji bzhin 'jog pa ma gtogs pa/ /dmigs gtad zhen pas mi 'ching 'tshal/

/rig pa chos zad blo 'das don/ /gom na rang mal chos sku 'di/ /ye thob 'bras bu ma gtogs pa/ /phyi dus re dog mi bskyed 'tshal/ /yang gsang gnad 'dus rdo rje'i mgur/ /gol sa gzhi thog gcod pa 'di/ /chos nyid yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas khams gsum yongs grol shog /rdzogs pa chen po yang gsang bla na med pa gnad 'dus rdo rje'i mgur/ dbang po yang rab rnams kyis rtogs par bya ba'i don/ lta dgongs gcig pa'i gnas las gzhan du gsang bar gdams pa'i gnad/ theg pa'i rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su gsungs pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ chos rje rgyal sras chen po nyid lhun grub gling gi dben gnas na bzhugs pa'i dus su phyogs ris nas 'dus pa'i dad ldan rnams kyis/ bla ma rin po ches mdo'i grong dang sde dgon gyi gnas gang na'ang bde ba mi gda' bas/ sems nyid rtogs pa'i sgom chen pa ri khrod 'grim pa las skyid pa ma mthong bas/ nges 'byung skyo shas skye ba/ ri khrod dgon pa'i yon tan dran pa gcig mgur du bzhengs par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pa'i dus su/ ri khrod dgon pa ma zhes bya ba nges 'byung skyo shas skye ba 'di gsungs so/ /drin can bla ma rin po che/ /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mi 'bral spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gson dang dad ldan skye bo kun/ /gang la bltas kyang snying po med/ /snying nas dam chos byed re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /da res lam sna ma zin na/ /mi lus thob kyang don re chung*/ /zab mo'i de nyid sgom re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /'khrul med btsan sa ma zin na/ /dal 'byor thob kyang chud re gsan/ /chos sku'i gtan yul 'dzin re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /snang ba chos la ma bsgyur na/

/dbang po tshang yang don re chung*/ /nyin mtshan chos la brtson re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /rtag tu dge la ma 'bad na/ / mtho ris thob kyang don re chung*/ /tshogs gnyis las la 'bad re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /mi dge sdig pa ma spangs na/ /mi lus skyes kyang don re chung*/ /las ngan sdig sgrib sbyang re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis ma zin na/ /rje dpon bzang yang don re chung*/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mjal re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /dam pa'i grogs dang ma 'phrad na/ /mdza' bshes mang yang don re chung*/ /chos mdzad grogs dang 'grogs re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /zab mo'i chos dang ma mjal na/ /tha snyad mang yang don re chung*/ /snying po'i dam chos tshol re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /rang byung sems nyid ma mthong na/ /'khrul pa'i gza' tshang mthun yang 'bral/ /'bral med don la sbyor re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /chog shes nor dang mi ldan na/ /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas spangs nas 'gro/ /gsog 'jog chags zhen bskyur re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /rig pa'i gtan yul ma zin na/ /sa mkhar mthon po brtsigs kyang 'jig /chos dbyings gnas la brten re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /sku gsum zhing khams ma sbyangs na/ /grong yul sde dgon 'ga' yang 'dor/ /mthar thug zad sar phyin re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /'chi med btsan sa ma zin na/ /skyes pa'i lus 'di tha ma 'dor/ /skye med chos la sbyang re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /dben pa'i ri ngogs ma bsten na/ /sde dgon grong yul nyon mongs 'phel/ /gcig pur dben par gnas re ran/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri khrod dgon pa ma las nges 'byung chos la bskul ba'i le'u ste dang po'o//

//yang de'i tshe dus ngan 'khor bar skyo ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ / snang ba 'di yi 'gyur lugs sam/ /skyo shas 'di yi skye lugs sam/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /dus tshod 'di yi ngan lugs sam/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i 'khrugs lugs sam/ /'pho 'degs 'di yi che lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /tshe srog 'di yi g.yo lugs sam/ /'chi rkyen 'di yi mang lugs sam/ /na shi 'di yi mod lugs sam/ / ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /yod pa 'di tsho'i ser sna 'am/ /med pa 'di tsho'i rtsol sgrub bam/ /che chung med pa'i 'dod pa'am/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /grong yul rnams kyi rgud lugs sam/ /mtha' mi hor sog mang lugs sam/ /khral dmag 'di yi che lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /skye bo rnams kyi rtsod lugs sam/ /bzang drin nyes kyi 'jal lugs sam/ /dad med sdig la rngams lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /'jig rten yongs kyi rgyal khrims sam/ /yod min med min gzugs brnyan nam/ /ngan byed ngo so'i mtho lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /dus bzhi'i rim pa 'chor lugs sam/ / char chu sgang gshongs che lugs sam/ /nad dang mu ge mang lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /sde dgon rnams kyi 'khrugs lugs sam/ /chos pa rnams kyi chags sdang ngam/ /'dod yon 'du 'dzi'i gnyer lugs sam/ / ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /btsun pa nor la gdung lugs sam/ / tshong dang so nam bun skyed dam/ /chos min bya byed mang lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /nor phyir ngo tsha gtong lugs sam/ /g.yo sgyu zol khram che lugs sam/ /sdom dang dam tshig 'chal lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /che chung med pa'i 'dod pa'am/ /'dul khrims khyad du gsod pa'am/ /rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i mang lugs sam/

/ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /'khrul snang bden par 'dzin lugs sam/ / chos dang rang rgyud 'dzol lugs sam/ /tha mal ngang du 'chi lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /mi shes rmongs pa mang lugs sam/ / shes kyang sgrub pa nyung lugs sam/ /dad dang nges 'byung med lugs sam/ / ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /chos ltar bcos pa mang lugs sam/ / chos bzhin mdzad pa nyung lugs sam/ /chos brgyad khur po che lugs sam/ / ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /bsams shing skyo ba skye lugs sam/ / gzhig cing snying po med lugs sam/ /brtags shing dgos med skye lugs sam/ /ri khrod dben pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri khrod dgon pa ma las/ snying nas skyo shas bskyed pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //yang de'i tshe mdo don chos la bskul ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ / yang cig gson dang skal ldan kun/ /brgya la res 'ga'i mi lus 'di/ /don med chud zos byed pa mang*/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /'khor ba pa la bde ba med/ /sdug par 'dug kyang sun mkhan med/ /bya dgos chos la nyan mkhan med/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /tshe 'di'i bya bas bslus bslus nas/ /phyi ma'i bde ba gnyer mkhan med/ /don chung las la mi tshe zad/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /mi rnams phal cher cer re long*/ /don chen bzhag nas don chung gnyer/ /'chi dus don med stong bar 'gro/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /dbang po tshang yang snying med mang*/ /yar 'gro'i chos la byed mkhan med/ /mar 'gro'i sdig pa sus thob byed/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba dar cig la/ / gtan du 'khrul pa'i las ngan sog /'chi khar 'gyod kyang phan pa med/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /sgyu ma'i nor la snying po med/ /yod cing je dgos sred pa 'phel/ /rang gis bsags pa gzhan gyis spyod/

/ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /mdza' bshes 'khor gyis dgos pa med/ /tshe 'dir 'ching zhing zag pa 'phel/ /mthun par 'grogs kyang tha mar 'bral/ / ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /byas pa'i las la zin pa med/ /byas shing bya dgos de bas mang*/ /'khrul pa'i snang bas nyin mtshan 'da'/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /tshe 'di'i chos la snying po med/ /gang ltar byas kyang bde ba med/ /ji ltar byas kyang legs pa med/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /mang po'i gnas na 'du 'dzis g.yengs/ /sde dgon yin yang phan pa med/ /chags sdang phyogs ris zag pa 'phel/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /snying nas dam chos mdzad pa kun/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang la/ /thar pa'i dam chos sgrub pa'i phyir/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri khrod dgon pa ma las/ dam chos snying nas bskul ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //yang de'i tshe ri khrod dben pa'i yon tan mgur du gsungs pa/ ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med/ /phyi ma'i dam chos ngang gis 'grub/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /skye bo mang po bsten 'dris med/ /phan tshun dgag sgrub zug rngu bral/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /gcig pur sgrub pa ngang gis 'phel/ / ngo srung sems 'dzin sdug bsngal med/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /'khrul pa'i bya byed ngang gis nyung*/ /ma zin dogs pa'i sdug bsngal med/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /gang byung chog shes nor gyis phyug

/ma ldang dogs pa'i sdug bsngal med/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /dus bzhir 'gyur ba'i rim pa yis/ /mi rtag skyo shas ngang gis 'phel/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /dad dang nges 'byung gsar du skye/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel bas/ /chos nyid rig pa'i gtan yul zin/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yon tan dang*/ /grub thob gong ma'i yon tan yang*/ /dben pa brten las byung bar gsungs/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim du gshegs/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i gnas mchog na/ /chos la bskul ba'i rim pa 'di/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bde yis/ /skal ldan rnams kyi snyan du 'bul/ /dge bas ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar shog /mngon par byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /gzhan don mdzad pa mtha' yas shog /ri khrod dgon pa ma las gnas kyi yon tan brjod pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed pa'i ri khrod dgon pa ma zhes bya ba'i mgur theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa yan pa blo bdes lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su gsungs pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rgyal sras chos rje nyid lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bla ma rin po che gling pa zhi bar gshegs zhes thos pas thams cad yid rlong rlong por gyur pa'i skabs su/ mya ngan chos nyid du grol ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ /skye shi med pa'i dpal mgon chos kyi rje/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rig stong skye med nam mkha' lta bu'i don/ /mya ngan gzhi grol chos nyid ngang der ltos/ /'khor ba'i mya ngan skye shi 'du 'bral yang*/

/don la med do stong pa'i ngo sprod yin/ / sems kyi zug rngu rang gis ma bzo bar/ /gnas lugs rig pa'i ngo sprod don la nyon/ /mya ngan gzhi grol chos sku'i ngo sprod yin/ /skyes pa'i dus na don la yod ma myong*/ /ltos dang gnas lugs lta ba'i ngang du grol/ /mtha' grol klong yangs chen por zang thal le/ /sdug bsngal stong gsal longs sku'i ngo sprod yin/ /myong ba'i dus na don la yod ma myong*/ /ltos dang rang sangs sgom pa'i ngang du grol/ /bar med phyal ba rjen par zang thal le/ /yid mi bde ba sprul sku'i ngo sprod yin/ /byung ba'i dus na don la yod ma myong*/ /ltos dang gnyis med spyod pa'i ngang du grol/ /shar grol rang yal gdod mar zang thal le/ /zug rngu ngo bo nyid sku'i ngo sprod yin/ /tshor ba'i dus na don la yod ma myong*/ /ltos dang rang byung 'bras bu'i ngang du grol/ /chos zad blo 'das chen por zang thal le/ /dmigs bsam bral ba'i rig pa byang chub klong*/ / mya ngan yul med bya rgyu ma rnyed do/ /stong gsal lhun grub rig pa chos dbyings klong*/ /sdug bsngal yul med bya rgyu ma rnyed do/ /'char gzhi ma 'gags rig pa 'gyur med klong*/ /yid mi bde med bya rgyu ma rnyed do/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i rig pa chos zad klong*/ /zug rngu yul med bya rgyu ma rnyed do/ kho bos chos rnams bsam 'das chos skur rtogs/ /bu khyod rnams kyang de ltar rtogs par mdzod/ /blo btags chos la bden par ma 'dzin par/ /gzhi bral mnyam pa chen po'i don la sbyongs/ /'khor ba'i mya ngan gdod ma'i dbyings grol nas/ /kun kyang chos rje bla ma'i zhal mthong shog /mya ngan gzhi grol rdo rje'i mgur/ rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ mtshungs med chos rje bla ma nyid rgya ma sgang na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ tshad nad kyi bsnyung gzhi drag pos bsnyungs pa la/

nye 'khor ba kun gyis sman bcos la sogs bskul ba'i tshe/ rtogs pa rtsal chen rdzogs pa na dga' shi skyid kyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /bde chen 'pho 'gyur mi mnga' ba/ /kun bzang rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dar gcig gson dang skal ldan kun/ /sngon nas chos nyid don la sbyangs/ /rkyen ngan rig pa'i grogs su shar/ /bcas bcos byed na rnal 'byor min/ /na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed byon/ /bcos nas 'tsho bar khas len yang*/ /sman dpyad bya rgyu bdag la med/ /na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje byon/ /bsrung na thub par khas len yang*/ /sngas srung byin rlabs zhu rgyu med/ /na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang byon/ /tshogs gsog bzlog par khas len yang*/ /sāts+tsha gtor zhus bya rgyu med/ /na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /mkhyen rab 'phags pa 'jam dpal byon/ /cho gas bslu bar khas len yang*/ /mdos dang rten 'brel bya rgyu med/ /na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /thams cad mi bden 'khrul par mthong*/ /gsog 'jog zhen pa ma byas pas/ /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas yod ma myong*/ /rim gro spang dag bya rgyu med/ /na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /yid la phreng ba su yang med/ /kha chems bzhag rgyu gang yang med/ / tshig rkang gcig chad dam snyam pas brtag na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /'chi med rig pa'i don la sbyangs/ /'byung bzhi'i phung po nam yang 'jog /rig pa'i gnas lugs btsan sa zin/ /na dga' shi skyid rnal 'byor lags/ /glu 'di yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge sbyor rkyen dang 'phrad na mngon/ /tshig 'di ma brjed yid la zungs/ /dge bas bde chen mchog thob shog /thog 'gel snyems thag bcad pa/ na dga' shi skyid rdo rje'i mgur/ rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa dge'o/

/༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ yang de nyid kyi dus su rkyen snang lam du khyer ba na ba lam slong gi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /dga' bde'i ngang la rtag tu bzhugs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yang cig gson dang skal ldan kun/ /na ba chos kyi skul rkyen yin/ /mi dga'i spang blo bdag la med/ /nyams len bde sdug kun la dgos/ khyed la gsal 'debs bshad kyi nyon/ /na bas tshe 'di'i zhen pa spong*/ /mi rtag 'chi ba rjes su dran/ /cis kyang dgos med rgyud la skye/ /na ba zhen log gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas dad dang nges 'byung skye/ /cis kyang mi phan chos rang dran/ /snying nas yid 'byung skyo shas skye/ /na ba thar lam gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas tshogs gnyis skul rkyen byed/ /gtong phod sbyin pa'i sa bon 'debs/ /dkar po'i las la bag chags 'jog /na ba dge ba'i gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas sngon gyi las ngan 'dzad/ /da lta'i las dang nyon mongs sbyong*/ /phyi ma'i las ngan mgo gnon pas/ /na ba sgrib sbyong gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas phyi ma ngan song du/ /skye nges myong 'gyur 'dir 'dren pas/ /gnyen po'i nang nas bla na med/ /na ba bde legs gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas phung po'i zhen pa bzlog /rang gzhan lus la chags pa spong*/ /chags sdang nyon mongs rang 'gag pas/ /na ba nges legs gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas gdung sems mos gus skyed/ /byin rlabs 'jug cing rtogs pa skye/ /chos mos lhag pa'i shes rab skye/ /na ba lam bzang gsal 'debs yin/ /na ba'i yon tan dran byas nas/ /sems can kun gyi nad bsal phyir/ /rang nyid na bar rab dmigs pas/ /na ba sems bskyed gsal 'debs yin/ /na ba snang ba ma 'gag sku/ /zug rngu brjod pa sngags kyi gsung*/ /bltas pas rig stong skye med thugs/ /na ba bskyed rim gsal 'debs yin/ /na ba rang gsal thabs mchog la/ /brtags pas stong gsal shes rab ngang*/

/gnyis med zung 'jug rnam par dag /na ba rdzogs rim gsal 'debs yin/ /na ba bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /zug rngu gsol 'debs brjod pa'i dbyangs/ /bltas pas shar grol byin rlabs dang*/ /na ba lam bzang gsal 'debs yin/ /na ba'i sems la tshur bltas pas/ /ngo bo stong pa rang bzhin gsal/ /'char tshul ma 'gag cir yang snang*/ /na ba sku gsum gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas rig pa'i dbyings la sbyor/ /brtags pas yul med stong pa'i ngang*/ /rang mal gdod mar phyam brdal le/ /na ba chos sku'i gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas rang sangs ngang gdangs rnyed/ /brtags pas rang gnas bsam gtan ngang*/ /bar med phyal bar rjen khres se/ /na ba longs sku'i gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas 'char gzhi rtsa bral mthong*/ /brtags pas rang yal rjes med ngang*/ /shar grol ris med stong sangs se/ /na ba sprul sku'i gsal 'debs yin/ /ma na ba la rtsal sbyong byas/ /na ba'i dus na bogs su 'byin/ /thams cad rig pa'i rgyan du shar/ /na ba dge sbyong gsal 'debs yin/ /na bas rig pa dngas snyig 'byed/ /na bas 'byung ba'i rang gdangs ston/ /na bas rnal 'byor srang la 'debs/ /na ba shan 'byed gsal 'debs yin/ /nga rang gu yang blo bde yin/ /dam chos rdzogs pa chen po yin/ /rkyen snang chos nyid rang grol yin/ /thams cad rig pa'i gsal 'debs yin/ /dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /bde chen byang chub mchog thob shog /na ba lam khyer rdo rje'i mgur/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sna tshogs rang grol gyis gsungs pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ mtshungs med rgyal sras bla ma nyid lhun grub gling gi dben gnas na bzhugs pa'i dus su zhen pa bzhi bral gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs shing*/ /dngos grub kun gyi yid bzhin gter/ /'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gzung ba'i yul dang 'dzin pa'i sems/ /gnyis med gdod nas dag pa'i ngang*/

/gzhi med nam mkha' lta bur mthong*/ /gzung 'dzin zhen pa bral ba lags/ /nyon mongs ye shes spang gnyen blo/ /gnyis med rang byung ye shes ngang*/ /gang shar ye nas grol bar mthong*/ /spang gnyen zhen pa bral ba lags/ /lta sgom sems dang spyod 'bras blo/ /gnyis med rig stong gcig pu'i ngang*/ /ris med zang thal rjen par mthong*/ /tha dad zhen pa bral ba lags/ /bskyed rdzogs sems dang byar med blo/ /gnyis med rtsa bral stong pa'i ngang*/ /chos zad blo 'das chen por mthong*/ /bya rtsol zhen pa bral ba lags/ /zhen pa bzhi bral rdo rje'i mgur/ /chos med yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /skal ldan rnams kyi thugs la zhog /dge bas 'bad med yongs grol shog /zhen pa bzhi bral rdo rje'i mgur/ rtogs pa gcig chod du grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa dge'o/ /༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ ngharma nghā tu ye/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i mkha' klong yangs par rtogs pa chos nyid du grol ba'i mtshungs med bla ma nyid/ lhun grub gling gi dben gnas na bzhugs pa'i tshes bcu'i tshogs gral du skal bzang gi rnal 'byor pa rnams la/ khams gsum ye grol chen por la bzla ba 'khor ba dong sprugs rdo rje'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings khyab gdal kun tu bzang mo'i ngang*/ /'du 'bral med pa rang byung ye shes la/ /khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs chen por 'dud/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i chos nyid don gyi dbyings/ /blang dor med pa byang chub sems kyi klong*/ /snang srid chos kun ye nas rnam dag pas/ /'khor ba dong sprugs rdo rje'i glu la nyon/ /'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /gdod nas ma skyes rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /'di zhes mi mtshon smra bsam brjod las 'das/ /mkha' mnyam klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs so/ /khams gsum rigs drug bde sdug 'khrul snang kun/

/rmi lam ngang bzhin ma skyes stong pa'i ngang*/ /snang ba'i dus na rang bzhin yod ma myong*/ /chos nyid klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs so/ /'khor rgyu 'khor rkyen las dang nyon mongs kun/ /bag chags 'khrul pa glo bur ming tsam ste/ /gzhi rtsa rten med chos dbyings gdod ma'i ngang*/ /sems nyid klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs so/ /snang sems gzhi med du bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //phyi rol gzugs sogs yul du snang ba'i chos/ /phyogs cha dngos med chu zla mig yor bzhin/ /snang bas stong la gzugs bral yangs sangs che/ /yul med klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs so/ /nang gi sems la kha dog dngos po med/ /'di zhes mi mtshon bsam dang bral ba yi/ /mtha' dang dbus med mkha' ltar dag pa'i ngang*/ /'dzin med klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /bar gyi dmigs myong lus sems rten 'di yang*/ /ra ri 'al 'ol bar snang 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /lus ngag stong gsal sgyu ma rang snang tsam/ /rten med klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /dbang po yul dang rnam shes chos rnams kun/ /med la gsal snang dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /rang bzhin bden med gzhi bral mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /ye stong klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /gzung 'dzin rten med du bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //rig pa'i ngang 'dir phyi nang bar med pas/ /gzung 'dzin yul sems rten med nam mkha' 'dra/ /gcig las ma g.yos thams cad gdod ma'i ngang*/ /ka dag klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /phyi ltar snang yang yul med rig pa'i klong*/ /nang ltar snang yang 'dzin med ye shes klong*/ /bar ltar snang yang rten med stong pa'i klong*/ /lhun grub klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /phyi dang nang med rig pa mkha' ltar yangs/ /zang nge thal le rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /rang byung ye shes kun tu bzang po'i klong*/ /chos zad klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/

/rig stong chos zad du bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //lta ba'i yul med bsgom pa'i dmigs gtad med/ /spyod pa'i ris med 'bras bu'i 'dod blo zad/ /bya rgyu'i chos med rgya yan rig pa'i 'gros/ / gnas lugs klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /rgyu 'bras chos kun byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /byas kyang chog ste rang bzhin bzhag kyang chog /nan tar byas na bya rgyu med pa lags/ /byar med klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ / zang nge thal le rgya yan rig pa'i klong*/ /rang byung klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /chos zad blo 'das su bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dgongs don gsang ba'i rig pa rang shar bas/ /ma spangs bzhin du nyon mongs gzung 'dzin dag /las dang bag chags rang grol zang thal le/ /rnam dag klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /byang chub sems kyi dgongs pa rang shar bas/ /ma btsal ngang du yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /sku dang ye shes zhing khams rang snang sangs/ /'od gsal klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /btang bzhag med pa'i bsam gtan rang shar bas/ /'bad rtsol gnyen po'i lam la ma brten par/ /bde gsal mi rtogs nyi zla mtha' dbus med/ /nyams rtogs klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /dgongs don rang shar du bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //g.yo zol med pa'i rang lus khang bzang du/ /bying rgod med pa'i rig pa rang gsal bas/ /'pho 'gyur med pa chos sku'i gtan srid zin/ /thog ma'i klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes rlung bcings pas/ /'od rtsa rnam dag kun bzang thig le gsal/ /mtha' dbus med par thams cad sangs rgyas zhing*/ /ye shes klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /gzhi nas phyam phyam gdod nas me re re/ /mtha' dbus khyab brdal 'od gsal gdod ma'i ngang*/ /snang bzhi zad pas rang gsal chos sku'i dbyings/ /lhun grub sbubs su 'khor ba dong sprugs so/

/gnas gsum chos nyid du bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //chos nyid rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rtse/ /gang dang mi 'dra kun las 'phags pas na/ /'di dang su 'phrad tshe 'di'i grol ba thob/ /mthar thug klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /thog med bskal pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed nas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs pas/ /'di la 'jug pa'i skyes bu skal ba rab/ /byang chub klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs sam/ /ye nas lhun grub klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ /gnyis med rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas/ /ji bzhin glur blangs dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /kun bzang klong du 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /chos dang gang zag la bsngags pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //mchog gsang rdzogs pa chen po rdo rje rtse mo'i glu/ 'khor ba dong sprugs ma zhes bya ba chos nyid zad sar 'khyol ba'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ dbang po yang rab rnams kyi rtogs pa la bzla ba'i don du gsungs pa'o/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa'i snying po don gyi mgur rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /

༈ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi rdo rje'i glu sum cu bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥmaṅga la swa sti sid+dhi pha la hoḥ lhun grub phun sum tshogs lnga'i zhing*/ /ye nas bkra shis dpal 'bar ba/ /dngos grub yid bzhin char chen 'bebs/ /mchog gsum bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di chos dbyings gdod ma'i zhing*/ /mgon 'di chos rje kun tu bzang*/ /'khor 'di ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /chos 'di rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /dus 'di gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di 'og min stug po bkod/ /mgon 'di chos rje rnam snang mdzad/ /'khor 'di rgyal sras dag pa'i tshogs/ /chos 'di bla med theg pa che/ /dus 'di rtag pa 'khor mo'i gzhi/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing*/ /mgon 'di chos rje mi bskyod pa/ /'khor 'di rgyal sras dag pa'i tshogs/ /chos 'di bla med theg pa che/ /dus 'di rtag pa 'khor mo'i gzhi/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di lho phyogs dpal ldan zhing*/ /mgon 'di chos rje rin chen 'byung*/ /'khor 'di ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /chos 'di rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /dus 'di gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di nub phyogs bde ldan zhing*/ /mgon 'di chos rje 'od dpag med/ /'khor 'di ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /chos 'di rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ /dus 'di gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ / gnas 'di byang phyogs las rab zhing*/ /mgon 'di chos rje don yod grub/ / 'khor 'di ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /chos 'di rang bzhin rdzogs pa che/ / dus 'di gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di 'og min chos dbyings zhing*/

/mgon 'di drug pa rdo rje 'chang*/ /'khor 'di grub pa rigs sngags 'chang*/ /chos 'di gsang sngags bla na med/ /dus 'di rtag pa rgyun gyi gzhi/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di dga' ldan dag pa'i zhing*/ /mgon 'di sprul sku rdo rje sems/ /'khor 'di rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror bcas/ /chos 'di gsang ba don gyi dbyings/ /dus 'di rdzogs ldan dang po la/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di lcang lo can gyi zhing*/ /mgon 'di phyag na rdo rje dpal/ /'khor 'di mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin tshogs/ /chos 'di nges don bla na med/ /dus 'di gdul bya ji srid bar/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di dur khrod chen po'i zhing*/ /mgon 'di rig 'dzin chen po'i tshogs/ /'khor 'di rig can dam pa bzhi/ /chos 'di gsang chen thig le bzhi/ /dus 'di chos 'byung chen po bzhi/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di ri bo rtse lnga'i zhing*/ /mgon 'di paṇa chen bi ma la/ / 'khor 'di rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /chos 'di yang gsang bla na med/ / dus 'di bskal pa ma zhig bar/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ / gnas 'di o rgyan rnga yab gling*/ /mgon 'di rang byung pad+ma rgyal/ /'khor 'di mkha' 'gro dpag tu med/ /chos 'di gsang sngags rdo rje theg/dus 'di 'jig rten ji srid bar/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di gar bzhug chos kyi dbyings/ /mgon 'di snyan rgyud rin po che/ /'khor 'di dad ldan bsags pa rab/ /chos 'di a ti snying po'i don/ /dus 'di phrin las ji srid bar/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /gnas 'di skal bzang gdul bya'i zhing*/ /mgon 'di chos rje rin po che/ /'khor 'di las can dbang po rab/ /chos 'di yang gsang rdzogs pa che/ /dus 'di nyin mtshan chos kyi 'da'/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /dgongs pa brda dang snyan brgyud kyi/

/bkra shis dam pa 'di brjod pas/ /rang bzhin bde legs dpal 'bar zhing*/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ma bkra shis rdo rje'i glu/ rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su mdzad pa dge'o/ /glu 'di la bla ma'i byin rlabs yod/ /tshig 'di la yi dam mkha' 'gro chags/ /blo 'di la dam can rgya mtsho 'du/ /bkra shis nyi ma shar ba lags/ /༈ tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs rgya mtsho nas/ /'dod 'byung nor bu rin po che/ /gang 'dod dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gza' gtad bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde ngas/ /dad ldan 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /rang snang bde ba'i chos gzhas 'bul/ /mi chos spang nas lo shas song*/ /da lta dam chos snying po byed/ /'jig rten snang ba bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ /gu yangs pa'i snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /yan pa blo bde'i snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /rang snang bde ba'i chos gzhas 'bul/ /ma rig mun pa'i sangs zhad la/ /pha yul spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta phyogs med ri khrod 'grim/ /chags sdang 'ching ba bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /gnyen bshes spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta bshes med gu yangs pas/ /nye 'brel skyong dgos bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /'khor 'dab spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta dpon med g.yog med ngang*/ /kha ta 'ching res bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /sde tshan spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta phyogs 'dzin chags sdang bral/ /nye ring snang ba bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /ngo srung spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta snang ba thad kar gcod/ /sems 'dzin sdug bsngal bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /bya byed spangs nas lo shas song*/

/da ltar byar med sos dal ngang*/ /ma zin dogs pa bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /gsog 'jog spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta chags med zhen med ngang*/ /phyi tshis 'dun ma bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /zhen 'dod spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta gang byung grogs su 'char/ /'di yin gtad so bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /che drags spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta sprang po gu yang pa/ /ming gzugs pho sgo bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /'jig rten spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta tshe 'di'i zhen pa thong*/ /chos brgyad khur po bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /dgos med skyes nas lo shas song*/ /da lta gang byung tshogs su gtong*/ /ser sna sdug bsngal bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /bstan la zhugs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta bslab gsum dam tshig ldan/ /nyams chag zhig ral bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /thos bsam byas nas lo shas song*/ /da lta tshig don gnas la mkhas/ /the tshom som nyi bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ / mdo rgyud sbyangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta phyi nang grub mtha' shes/ /tha snyad mngon rlom bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /dam pa bsten nas lo shas song*/ /da lta gong ma'i byin rlabs zhugs/ /mos gus ltem rkyang bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ngang*/ /tha mal 'khrul rtog bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /phyogs med sbyangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta gdams ngag kun la mkhas/ /phyogs gcig kha 'dzin bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /gnas lugs rtogs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta chos zad blo 'das ngang*/ /mthar 'dzin lta ba bdag la med/

/bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /chos nyid bsgoms nas lo shas song*/ /da lta rang rig 'od gsal ngang*/ /stong bsgom mun rdo bdag la med/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /dngos 'dzin spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta mkha' mnyam rgyal ba'i thugs/ /lta dgongs zad sar bskyal ba lags/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /dmigs 'dzin spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta chos nyid gdod ma'i ngang*/ /sgom pa blo las 'das pa lags/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /dgag sgrub spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta rang grol chos nyid ngang*/ /spyod pa gza' gtad bral ba lags/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /re dogs spangs nas lo shas song*/ /da lta zang thal chos nyid ngang*/ /'bras bu rang byung ye shes la/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gang ltar byas kyang skyid par byung*/ /ji ltar byas kyang bde bar byung*/ /bde skyid mtsho mo rdol ba lags/ /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ gu yangs pa'i snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /yan pa blo bde'i snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /rang snang ma rig mun pa'i sangs zhad la/ /glu tshig bzang don du legs pa 'di/ /gnas lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su/ /chos theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ / mi gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /sku gsum ye shes mchog gi gnas/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /byang chub rgya mtsho mtha' yas shog /ces pa'i bde skyid mtsho mo ma 'di rgyal sras bzod pas bskul ba'i ngor gsungs pa'o// // ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dngos grub ye shes rgya mtsho las/ /'dod rgu yid bzhin rin chen gter/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /skyes pa 'di tsho'i 'chi lugs som/ /sgyu ma'i lus kyis bslu bslu 'dra/ /skye shi med pa'i sems nyid la/ /'gyur med btsan sa bzung na legs/ /'dus pa 'di tsho'i 'bral lugs som/

/gnyen 'dun grogs kyis bslu bslu 'dra/ /rang byung ye shes snying po'i don/ /'bral med btsan sa bzung na legs/ /bsags pa 'di tsho'i 'dzad lugs som/ /sgyu ma'i nor gyis bslu bslu 'dra/ /zas nor longs spyod yo byad kun/ /sbyin pa'i gter du sbas na legs/ /mthon po dma' mor 'gyur lugs som/ /che dregs 'byor pas bslu bslu 'dra/ /rtag tu dma' ba'i sa bzung nas/ /dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub na legs/ /dbang med sdig pa'i las la sbyor/ /'jig rten dpon gyis bslu bslu 'dra/ /'di phyir legs pa'i lam ston pa/ /bla ma dam pa bsten na legs/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i chos/ /tshe 'di'i 'khrul pas bslu bslu 'dra/ /thar pa'i lam mchog zhi ba'i chos/ /zab mo'i de nyid bsgom na legs/ /chags zhen nyon mongs 'ching ba'i gzhi/ /mdza' bshes 'khor gyis bslu bslu 'dra/ /nyin mtshan sgo gsum chos kyis 'da'/ /chos mdzad grogs dang 'grogs na legs/ /'khor ba'i btson ra zug rngu can/ /pha yul khyim gyis bslu bslu 'dra/ /chags sdang 'du 'dzis dben pa'i gnas/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grim na legs/ /'khrul ba'i brel dos nyin mtshan 'da'/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i bslu bslu 'dra/ /'khrul snang tshe 'di'i bya ba kun/ /cog bzhag lings kyis bskyur na legs/ /sems dang sems byung 'khor ba'i yid/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pas bslu bslu 'dra/ /mi rtog rang byung ye shes don/ /chos nyid 'od gsal goms na legs/ /gnyen po dran rtog goms tshul las/ /drod rtags zhen pas bslu bslu 'dra/ /rig stong chos zad rjen pa'i ngang*/ /lta sgom zad sar skyol na legs/ /legs pa dam pa rdo rje'i mgur/ gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas khams gsum yongs grol shog /legs pa dam pa'i bkra shis shog /legs pa dam pa ma zhes bya ba'i glu/ gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs pa dge'o// // ༈ nor bu nyi ma chos kyi glu/

'dod 'byung dpag bsam yid bzhin mkha'/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du che/ /rta bdun rgyas pa pad+mo'i gnyen/ /dag pa'i mkha' la shar ba'i tshe/ /gling bzhi'i mun pa sangs pa dang*/ /mnyam du ge sar pad+mo rgyas/ /rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i rtsal/ /rang rig mkha' la shar ba'i tshe/ /ma rig mun pa sangs pa dang*/ /mnyam du gnas lugs rtogs pa rgyas/ /'jig rten snang byed 'gro ba'i mig /mtshan mo'i bdag po shar ba'i tshe/ /'od dkar snang ba 'gyed pa dang*/ /mnyam du me tog kun+da rgyas/ /dgongs pa 'gyur med chos sku'i klong*/ /ngang gdangs 'od gsal shar ba'i tshe/ /bde gsal 'od stong 'phro ba dang*/ /mnyam du mi rtog ye shes rgyas/ /bsod nams rgyas pa'i gzi 'od kyis/ /nyi zla'i gzi 'od 'phrog pa'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal snang byed nub pa dang*/ /mnyam du gza' skar snang ba rgyas/ /rlung 'pho ba bcu drug dbyings su nub/ /nyi zla sgra gcan zos pa'i tshe/ /gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs nub pa dang*/ /mnyam du 'od gsal snang ba rgyas/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin po che/ / rgyal mtshan rtse mor btags pa'i tshe/ /dgos 'dod gsol ba btab pa dang*/ /ci 'dod dngos grub char du 'bab/ /sems nyid yid bzhin rin po che/ /rang rig rtogs pa'i rtser phyin nas/ /ma yengs goms pas brtson pa dang*/ /mnyam du yon tan char chen 'beb/ /sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba la/ /dad ldan skye rgus bsten pa'i tshe/ /'di phyi'i don gnyis 'grub pa dang*/ /mnyam du yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa la/ / brten nas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /ci bsam chos su 'grub pa dang*/ / mnyam du dngos grub thams cad 'grub/ /glu dpe bzhi don dang rnam pa brgyad/ /bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba 'di/ /theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor ba/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos sbyar/ /dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /theg pa mchog la rab zhugs nas/

/dpal mgon bla ma mnyes byed cing*/ /nyin mtshan chos kyi 'da' bar shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ byas nas/ thams cad bde chen sangs rgyas zhing*/ /snang ba rgya grol rnal 'byor lags/ /chos zer ba 'di byas kyang chog la bzhag kyang chog /nan tar byas na bya rgyu med pa lags/ nor bu nyi ma ma zhes bya ba rdo rje'i glu/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ rnam grol zla ba zhes bya bas bskul ba'i ngor sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dngos grub rin chen char 'bebs pa'i/ /dpal mgon bla ma rin po che/ /mi 'bral spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs/ /pha yul spangs nas ri khrod 'grim/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyab tu bskyur/ /thar pa dam pa'i lha chos byas/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /phyogs ris med pa'i thos bsam byas/ /the tshom blo yi mun pa bsal/ /chos dang chos min blang dor shes/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rnams dang mjal/ /dpag tu med pa'i mos gus skyes/ /byin rlabs nyams dang rtogs pa shar/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /'khor ba 'khrul ba'i rang bzhin la/ /nges 'byung skyo shas drag po skyes/ /mi rtag 'chi bas bskul ma btab/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /tshe 'di'i 'khrul snang bya ba kun/ /thams cad byas pa don med mthong*/ /ma byas chos la btsan sa bzung*/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /nor yod kun gyis sdug bsngal mthong*/ /nor med sems kyi rgyan du shar/ /chog shes 'phags pa'i nor dang ldan/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /rang don bdag 'dzin 'ching ba bcad/ /gzhan don byang chub sems la sbyangs/ /gnyis don snang ba chos la bsgyur/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /yangs so che'o chos kyi dbyings/ /nam mkha' 'dra ste spros dang bral/ /lta ba rtogs pa'i tshad du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/

/ bde'o gsal lo mi rtog dang*/ /nyi zla 'dra ste 'od re gsal/ /sgom pa dag pa'i tshad du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /thams cad rang snang gzung 'dzin bral/ /sgyu ma 'dra ste bden zhen med/ /spyod pa 'byongs pa'i tshad du phyin/ /'dun ma rtse mor phyin pa lags/ /rang rig dri med chos kyi sku/ /nor bu 'dra ste lhun gyis grub/ /'bras bu dag pa'i tshad du phyin/ /'dun ma legs pa'i bro brdung 'di/ /chos theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas khams gsum yongs grol shog /gzhas dga' yo skyid do rdo rje'i spun/ /rang snang dam pa'i chos la bsgyur/ /oṃ dang ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥya/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ gu yangs pa'i snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /yan pa blo bde'i snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs zhad la/ /zhes pa 'di nyid slob dpon rin chen shes rab la gsungs pa'o/ / ༈ dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bde chen thar pa'i grong khyer du/ /ma lus 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gdod nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /'gyur ba med pa de bzhin nyid/ /blo bral nam mkha' lta bu ni/ /gzhi gdod nas dag pa chos sku lags/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa rig pa'i ngang*/ /phyi nang yul med zang ka ma/ /ye babs ma bcos dgongs pa 'di/ /lam bsam brjod 'das pa'i rang bzhin lags/ /ye sangs rgyas pa'i rig pa la/ /yang sangs rgyas pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ /sgrib med zang thal gcer bu 'di/ /'bras bu re dogs bral ba lags/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum rdo rje'i glu/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /lhun grub gling gi gnas su sbyar/ /dge bas 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags so/ /gnyis gsum drug byas nas/ /zad sar skyol ba'i rnal 'byor pa lags so/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum rdo rje'i glu/

theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis rtogs ldan byang rdor gyis bskul ba'i ngor bkod pa rdzogs so/ / ༈ rlabs chen tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*/ /thugs rje yid bzhin sprin tshogs las/ /byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ /bla ma kun la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /thar pa dam pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /rang don bdag 'dzin 'ching ba bcad/ /nyan thos theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /gzung ba yul gyi chos rnams kun/ /snang la zhen med chu zla 'dra/ /rten 'brel bsgoms pas nyon mongs grol/ /rang rgyal theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /gzhan don brtson pas go bgos te/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i lam zhug nas/ /chos kun mkha' ltar rnam dag pas/ /byang sems theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /sgo gsum rtag par dge ba yis/ /rab dkar zab mo'i chos la brtson/ /bya bas dngos grub mchog la sbyor/ /kri ya'i theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /lus dang ngag sems rab zhi bas/ /rig gsum snying po'i don chen sgrub/ /dpag med spyod pa rlabs che bas/ /u pa'i theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /chos kun ye nas mngon byang lngas/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po rab brtan zhing*/ /rnal 'byor dam pa rab bsgrub pas/ /yo ga'i theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /snang srid ye nas sangs rgyas zhing*/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du rab rtogs nas/ /rim gnyis zab gsal gnyis su med/ /ma hā'i theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /thams cad dbyings dang ye shes dang*/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /bde stong ye shes zung 'jug dang*/ /a nu'i theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /thams cad rang byung ye shes ngang*/ /rgyu 'bras bya rtsol gnyis med pas/ /a ti'i theg pa lhun gyis grub/ /theg pa rim dgu'i chos gzhas 'di/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ dang byas nas/ /don gnyis 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags so/ /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor lags so/ /theg pa rim dgu ma zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong rab 'byams kyis/ lhun grub gling gi dben gnas su sbyar ba dge'o/ /theg pa rim dgu ma 'di dge 'dun rin chen ming sring gnyis kyis bskul ba'i don du gsungs pa dge'o/ /༈ dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro zhing*/ /dngos grub rin chen char 'bebs pa/ /rang byung pad+ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /phyi ru bltas pas snang ba'i yul/ /thams cad o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ /'gro kun lha dang lha mo'i tshul/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /nang du bltas pas rig pa'i ngang*/ /gang shar rang grol 'dzin pa med/ /chos zad blo 'das ye shes ngang*/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /phar la bltas pas sgyu ma'i yul/ /gang snang bden med rmi lam tsam/ /rang snang gdod ma'i dbyings su grol/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /tshur la bltas pas sgyu ma'i lus/ /chu zla mig yor snang ba tsam/ /bden med stong pa'i rang gzugs gcig /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /yar la bltas pas mya ngan 'das/ /chos sku ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /mkha' ltar dri med rnam par dag /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /mar la bltas pas srid pa'i chos/ /khams gsum rmi lam sgyu ma tsam/ /snang bzhin stong pas gzhi bral ngang*/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /lus la bltas pas lha yi sku/ /bar snang dag pa'i 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang*/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /ngag la bltas pas sngags kyi sgra/ /grags stong skye med brag cha bzhin/ /grags pa rang bzhin med pa'i ngang*/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /sems la bltas pas chos nyid ngang*/ /stong gsal dag pa'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /blo bral rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/
