/rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /gshis la bltas pas gdod ma'i ngang*/ /rang byung ye shes mtha' dbus bral/ /don dam pad+ma 'byung gnas ngang*/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /sems la bltas pas gzung 'dzin med/ /yangs so che'o rgyal ba'i thugs/ /kun bzang dgongs par lhun gyis grub/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /gang la bltas kyang chos zad ngang*/ /lhug pa phyal ba bar mtshams med/ /rgya grol nam mkha' phyam phyam gcig/rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /gang bltas gu yangs blo bde'o/ /pad+ma rgyal dang 'du 'bral med/ /bsam rgu'i re ba 'grub pa lags/ /rang sems snang ba'i bde zhad la/ /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ /o rgyan gu ru'i gces phrug lags/ /gsum drug dgu byas nas/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba lags/ /oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ o rgyan byin rlabs rdo rje'i glu/ /phyogs med yan pa blo bde yis/ /dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs la 'bul/ /dge bas sku lnga lhun grub shog /o rgyan byin rlabs ma zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ lhun grub gling gi gnas mchog tu gsungs pa'i phrin las phun sum tshogs par gyur cig / ༈ rgyal sras bla ma nyid lhun grub gling du bzhugs pa'i dus su skal ldan 'ga' yis zhus pa/ chang 'di ngo lkog tsam las thams cad 'thungs kyang*/ sgos su sgom chen pa kho nas 'thung zhes bka' gdams 'dul 'dzin la sogs pa'i grwa sa pa rnams kha zer bar gda' bas/ thams cad 'thung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ chang gi yon tan legs pa zhig chos gzhas su mdzad par zhu zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ chang gi byung rabs yon tan brjod pa bdud rtsi'i zil mngar la rdo rje'i glu gsungs pa/ na mo gu ru/ chang gi yon tan la bsngags pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chang gi mes po rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mchod/

/skal bzang rnams kyi btung ba'i mchog gyur pa'i/ /bdud rtsi chang gi yon tan bshad kyi nyon/ /yid 'ong mtho ris lha yi grong khyer nas/ /bdud rtsi'i thig pa mchog gcig lhung ba ni/ /'dzam gling skye bo yongs kyis bsod nams las/ /'bru rnams bcud chags chang gi dwangs mar gyur/ /kha dog ro ldan sbrang rtsi lta bu la//dri bsung phun tshogs lha yi bdud rtsi bzhin/ /mthong na yid dga' bsten pas 'bral mi phod/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung bas bde ba myang na zhim pa ste/ /khong du song na lus sems mchog tu bde/ /snang ba bde khrol chos nyid rtogs pa 'dra/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thungs pa'i rjes la blo bde rang mal du/ /rtog med ngang la rgya yan gnyid phebs pas/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal bsam gtan 'byongs pa 'dra/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung pa'i mod la dga' ba'i gtam rnams dang*/ /yid 'ong snyan pa'i glu dbyangs du ma 'byung*/ /gzhan la mi 'jigs spobs pa dpag tu med/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /ro mchog brgyad ldan bdud rtsi chang nyid la/ / gtso bo'i ro mchog mngar skyur kha ba gsum/ /phyogs su ma chad gcig la kun tshang bas/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dang po mngar ba cung zad skyur ba'i ro/ /'bol zhing 'khril ba kha bas 'bral mi phod/ /brtags shing ngo mtshar ro mchog dpag tu med/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'thung bas lus bde gzi brjid 'phral la skye/ /mgrin pa'i mtsho rdol gre 'gyur phun sum tshogs/ /snang ba yid bde sems la dga' ba rnyed/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ / 'du ba snyoms shing nad rnams kun la phan/ /khyad par bad rlung 'dus pa sel bas na/ /sman rnams nang nas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gang du 'phrad na brel ba'ang dal gyur

zhing*/ /'thung ba'i mod la sems kyi sdug bsngal 'gag /nyin mtshan yun thung song ba mi tshor bas/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ / skyid sdug kun la rang bzhin dgos pa dang*/ /che chung kun gyis yongs su spyod pa dang*/ /gzhi byes kun tu med thabs med pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams sgrub kyang gleng ba'i gzhir dgos la/ /mdza' bshes 'dun kyang ngo dga'i skyes su dgos/ /gnyen 'dun tshogs kyang sna len phyir dgos pas/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /mthon por gyur pa'i mi dbang rgyal po nas/ /bla ma mchog dang bshes gnyen mkhas rnams dang*/ /khrims la dbang ba'i mi chen che rgus bsten/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /yul khams so so'i grong gi mi rnams dang*/ /sde dgon phal dang dben pa'i ri ngogs na'ang*/ /longs spyod kun gyi gzhi mdor bsten pas na/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /sgrin por rlom pa'i bka' gdams 'dul 'dzin dang*/ /mtshan nyid pa dang jo gdan la sogs kyang*/ /lkog tu 'thung zhing sred pa su bas che/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /skyes pa rnams kyang ci yod chang la 'jal/ /bud med rnams kyang bal skud gter bor 'jog /yon tan mkhan rnams bzo yi tshab tu 'jog /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /sngags bon rnams kyang rnga shang rin du 'jal/ /btsun pa rnams kyang btsun chas tshab tu 'jog /grub chen rnams kyang nyi ma gte bor 'jog /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i sgrub rdzas yin pa dang*/ /dbang dang byin rlabs chos sgo 'byed pa dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs lam gyi mthun rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod pa dang*/ /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bsten pa dang*/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod yin pa'i phyir/

/zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams 'du ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs rnams dgyes pa dang*/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /mi rnams kun kyang dga' bas bsten pa dang*/ /'dre rnams kun kyang zhim pas khyer ba dang*/ /lha rnams kun kyang dgyes pas rol pa'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dwangs ma 'phel bas lus sems bde ba dang*/ /bde drod bskyed pas ting 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ /rig ngar thon pas rtogs pa 'char ba'i phyir/ /zhim mngar chang gi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med/ /brjod kyis mi lang lha yi bdud rtsi bzhin/ /mi yul btung ba'i ro mchog dam pa 'di/ /rang gzhan kun gyis dgyes shing rol par mdzod/ /tshul 'di snang ba rgya yan rnal 'byor pa/ /rig pa gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dga' bde phyam brdal shog /chang gi yon tan la bsngags pa bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ma zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis mdzad pa'o/ /snang ba kun ban ma bun ma/ rig pa kun phyad ma phyod ma/ rang rgyud kun shag ma'i shig ma/ rang sems kun khral ma'i khrol ma/ dga' yal le/ skyid chil le/ ban ma bun mar ya/ phyad ma phyod mar ya/ shag ma shig mar ya/ khral ma khrol mar ya/ rgyob rgyob rgyob/ bdud rtsi chang gi rba klong de la cong nge ba gcig rgyob/ zhong nge ba gcig gsol/ khrol le ba gcig mchod/ ces gsungs so/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o/ / ༈

yang chos rje bla ma nyid lhun grub gling du bzhugs dus skal ldan rnams la gtad med rdo rje'i glu 'di gsungs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ gtad med yongs grol chos kyi rje/ /drin chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa'i/ /dngos grub kun 'byung e ma ho/ /yod yod 'dra la med bzhin snang*/ /'khor 'das sgyu ma rang snang chos/ /gdod nas gzhi rtsa bral ba'i ngang*/ /ma 'gag 'char tshul e ma ho/ /bden bden 'dra la mi bden pa/ /'khor ba 'khrul pa bslu ba'i chos/ /brtags na gzhi med stong pa'i ngang*/ /med pa gsal snang e ma ho/ /rdzun rdzun 'dra la mi rdzun pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa bden pa'i chos/ /sku dang ye shes bla med ngang*/ /mthar thug 'thob bya e ma ho/ /grub grub 'dra la ma grub pa/ /rang byung ye shes rig pa'i chos/ /stong gsal ma 'gags chos dbyings ngang*/ /kun gyi 'byung gnas e ma ho/ /ltos shig ltos shig ma lta zhig /bltas na lta ba yul dang bcas/ /ma bltas rig pa'i dbyings mi mthong*/ /bltas la ma bltas e ma ho/ /sgoms shig sgoms shig ma bsgoms shig /bsgom na dmigs gtad blo dang bcas/ /ma bsgoms sems nyid don mi mthong*/ /bsgom la ma bsgoms e ma ho/ /spyod cig spyod cig ma spyad cig /spyad na gnyis 'dzin rigs dang bcas/ /ma spyad dgag sgrub snyems mi chod/ /spyad la ma spyad e ma ho/ /thob cig thob cig ma thog cig /thob na thob byed gnyis dang bcas/ /ma thob mthar thug 'bras mi rnyed/ /thob la ma thob e ma ho/ /gyis shig gyis shig ma byed cig /byas na bya rtsol 'khor ba'i chos/ /ma byas thar lam bsgrod dus med/ /byas la ma byas e ma ho/ /yin la min pa yin pa'i chos/ /gtad med yongs grol rdzogs pa che/ /rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i blo la sbyongs/ /ma spangs dag pa e ma ho/ /yod la med pa yod pa'i chos/ /rang byung 'od gsal ngang la ltos/ /thams cad sku dang ye shes ngang*/

/ma btsal lhun grub e ma ho/ /stong la snang ba stong pa'i chos/ /rang snang chos zad gdod mar phyin/ / snang gsal lhun grub rin chen sbubs/ /kun bzang chos sku e ma ho/ / 'gal 'gal 'dra la mi 'gal ba/ /glu 'di gtad med rdo rje'i glu/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas khams gsum yongs grol shog /gtad med yongs grol rdo rje'i glu/ /rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa dge'o/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa e ma ho/ /zad sar skyol ba e ma ho/ /don gnyis lhun grub e ma ho/ /e ma ho ste ngo mtshar che/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / ༈ chos rje bla ma nyid lhun grub gling gi gnas na bzhugs pa'i dus/ khrid kyi dga' ston gyi tshe skal ldan rnams la mkha' 'gro don gyi dgongs pa rdo rje'i glu 'di gsungs so/ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dngos grub rin chen char 'bebs pa/ /yid bzhin bla ma rin po che/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud/ / ngo mtshar byin rlabs a la la/ /theg pa rim dgu'i mthar thug don/ /yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i rtse/ /chos rje bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /zad sar skyol pa a la la/ /ma btsal lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhi/ /ma bgrod ye nas nye ba'i lam/ /ma bsgrubs gdod nas grub pa'i 'bras/ /rang la rnyed pa a la la/ /chos dbyings mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams su/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i me long la/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i snang ba shar/ /pad+ma'i spyan gzigs a la la/ / las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs med ngang*/ /kun bzang dgongs pa zang thal le/ / stong gsal lhun grub ka dag dbyings/ /mngon du gyur pa a la la/ /dbyings nyid ka nas dag pa'i yul/ /stong gsal nam mkha' yangs pa 'di/ /chos dbyings mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams lags/ /phyi nang dbyings gcig a la la/ /sgo 'di gzung 'dzin dag pa'i sgo/ /rgya mtsho dwangs pa'i rang bzhin 'di/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i me long lags/ /phyi nang zang thal a la la/

/gzhi snang rig pa'i lhun grub gdangs/ /sku dang ye shes rang snang 'di/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i snang ba lags/ /stong gsal 'dzin med a la la/ /rang snang ma yengs gzigs pas dag /phyi nang ngang gnas bsam gtan 'di/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i spyan mchog lags/ /ma chags ting 'dzin a la la/ /ma 'gags shes rab thogs med ngang*/ /zang thal dgongs pa rang grol 'di/ / las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thogs med ngang*/ /chos dbyings gdod mar a la la/ /ka nas dag pa'i rig pa la/ /'phel 'grib med bzhin 'phel dang zad/ /snang bzhi chos sku rang mal du/ /rlung sems dag tshul a la la/ /gzhi las ma g.yos gdod ma'i ngang*/ /dgongs pa chos nyid bar med du/ /ma yengs mi gnas 'khor 'das grol/ /rang byung ye shes a la la/ /bla med rdzogs pa chen pa chen po'i don/ /dbang po yang rab spyod yul 'di/ /skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs/ /tshe 'dir grol ba a la la/ /mkha' 'gro 'dus pa rdo rje'i glu/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos blangs/ /dge bas 'khor ba dong sprugs te/ /bkra shis phun tshogs a la la/ /mkha' 'gro 'dus pa rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa yan pa blo bdes blangs pa/ glu 'di chos nyid don gyi glu/ /bro 'di mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i bro/ /bla ma yi dam byin rlabs yod/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong chags pa lags/ / ༈ yang chos rje bla ma nyid lhun grub gling na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sgom chen ri khrod du sdod ma zug pa kha cig 'khyams su 'gro ba la rdo rje'i mgur 'di gsungs pa/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dben pa'i gnas su dngos grub brnyes/ /bla ma grub thob rnams la 'dud/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /gong ma rnams kyang ri khrod bsten/ /ma tshugs 'khyams pa'i sgom chen kun/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /klong rdol gyi sgom khang khyer lags sam/

/da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /dgra kun gyi gnod 'tshe byung lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /khral dang gtser ba byung lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /grong dgon gyi kha 'dzin mdzad lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /khyi za long sprang mdzad lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /tshong dang so nam mdzad lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /mi chos kyi 'dun ma mdzad lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /grong dgon gyi chags sdang rtsod lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /'jig rten gyi kha lo bsgyur lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /'jig rten gyi brel do shom lags sam//da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /chos min gyi kun spyod skyong lags sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi ma spangs sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/

/sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /snying nas bsam mno legs po thongs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /tshe 'di'i 'khrul pas rig pa bslu/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /'jig rten chos la snying po med/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba myur du 'ong*/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ / bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ / 'gros mo che la ci phan nam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /skyas mo che la cis stongs sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bems rig bral tshe ci byed dam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ / sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bar do'i 'phrang la cis stong sam/ / da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /phyi ma'i lam sna e zin nam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /sems nyid gtan la e phebs sam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma e grub bam/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /gong ma'i rnam thar bskyang na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/

/bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /sgrub pa snying por byas na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs//bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /sgom pa yun du bsring na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /nges 'byung skyo shas skyes na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu brtson na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs//bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /cis kyang dgos med bsam na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /chags med zhen med skyang na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /tshe 'di blo yis btang na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /snying rus sdug sran bskyed na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bral/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bsags pa 'dzad cing mthon po lhung*/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /gang la'ang snying po med la ltos/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/

/phyogs bcur ma 'khyams bsdad na legs/ /mtshams dang 'dag sbyar byas na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /da res don chen bsgrub na legs/ /da dung ri khrod bsten na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod gnas na yod/ /sgom chen tsho ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod ma las/ sha tsha gros su 'debs pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //yang gcig gson dang skal ldan kun/ /'du 'dzi'i gnas na bde ba med/ /de la bsten pa'i nyes pa mang*/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na sdug bsngal gyi btson ra che/ /sde dgon na gzung 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dam/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na dug lnga'i 'khrug rtsod mang*/ /sde dgon na chags sdang gi zug rngu che/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na las ngan gyi sdong po rgyas/ /sde dgon na nyon mongs kyi me tog bkra/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na lags/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na 'khrul snang gi phya phyo mang*/ /sde dgon na 'dod chags kyi tsha rims 'bar/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na lags/ / bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na tshe 'dis brel dos zin/ /sde dgon na chos min gyi bya bas g.yengs/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ / bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na khral dmag gi gtser bas ded/ /sde dgon na las sna'i zer gyis bkol/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na 'thab rtsod kyi 'khrug long mod/ /sde dgon na nang tshan gyi chags sdang che/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/

/grol yul na phyogs ris kyi chags sdang rtsod/ /sde dgon na don med kyi khe drag 'then/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na rtag tu rnam g.yeng che/ /sde dgon na nyin mtshan 'du 'dzis 'da'/ /deng sang ri khrod 'gram na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na so tshis kyi bya bas brel/ /sde dgon na tshong dang so nam gyis g.yengs/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na gza' tshang gi skyong dgos mang*/ /sde dgon na dpon slob kyi sems las che/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na srung sdom gyi gnyen po 'chor/ /sde dgon na nyon mongs zag pa 'phel/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na tshe 'di don du gnyer/ /sde dgon na chos brgyad kyi khur po che/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /grong yul na mi tshe stong par zad/ /sde dgon na tha mal ngang du 'chi/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par

yod/ /grong yul gyi gnas la skyo ba skyes/ /sde dgon gyi gnas la yid 'byung skyes/ /deng sang ri khrod 'grim na legs/ /bde skyid ri khrod dben par yod/ /bde skyid ri khrod ma las/ grong yul gyi nyes pa bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // yang cig gson dang skal ldan kun/ /gang la bsam kyang snying po med/ /ci la bsams kyang skyo ba skyes/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /dben zhing nyams dga' rig pa 'dzin/ /sman ljongs nags dang gangs ris mdzes/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /phug dang brag ri'i khang bzang na/ /sman shing med tog 'bras bus brgyan/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /rtswa dang lo ma'i khang bzang dang*/ /chu gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /yid 'ong bung bas snyan sgrog cing*/ /bya dang ri dwags mang pos gang*/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /ngang gi chos 'phel rig pa dwangs/ /dus bzhi 'gyur bas blo sna thung*/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /dgra gnyen gang dang ma 'brel bas/ /chags sdang zag pa ngang gis med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /che chung gang dang ma 'brel pas/ /ngo srung sems 'dzin sdug bsngal med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /skye bo gzhan dang ma 'brel bas/ /zog dang tshul 'chos ngang gis med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /gcig pur rang dbang chos la thob/ /sus kyang tshe 'dir 'ching mkhan med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/

/bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /'jig rten rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med/ /chags sdang nyon mongs ngang gis 'grib/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /spyod lam dus drug thams cad du/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu chos kyis 'da'/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /mi rtag 'chi ba rjes su dran/ /dad dang nges 'byung skyo shas skye/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /tshe 'di'i chos dang rgyang bsring bas/ /rtag tu bya rgyu chos las med/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /rtag tu chos la dmigs pa'i phyir/ /spyod lam thams cad dge bar 'gyur/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /mkhas grub bla ma mchog la bsten/ /rtag par chos mdzad grogs dang 'grogs/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /snying nas mos gus gdung sems bskyed/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ / rtag tu sgrub pa snying por byed/ /nyams dang rtogs pa ngang gis 'char/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ / byas pa gcig la don che bas/ /mi lus rin chen don dang bcas/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /tshe 'dir yang bde ste phyi ma'ang bde/ /gtan du bde la spyod pa yin/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/ /rgas shing ri khrod je mthor thongs/ /skal ldan kun gyis de bzhin mdzod/ /ri ngogs dben par sgom du gshegs/ /bde skyid ri khrod kyi gnas na yod/

/bde skyid ri khrod rdo rje'i glu/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas mkha' mnyams 'gro ba kun/ /mngon par byang chub sangs rgyas shog /bde skyid ri khrod ma las/ yon tan bsngags pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // bde skyid ri khrod ma zhes bya ba/ phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis gsungs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang ri khrod 'grim/ /skal ldan kun kyang ri khrod la gshegs/ /rtag tu ri khrod dben pa bsten/ /gtan gyi don chen bsgrub par 'tshal/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / ༈ chos rje bla ma nyid lhun grub gling na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ skal ldan rnams la mya ngan chos nyid du grol ba rdo rje'i glu 'di blangs so/ / na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bde chen 'gyur med chos sku'i ngang*/ /rtag tu 'pho 'gyur med par bzhugs/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa/ /kun bzang bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /chos kun ye nas ma skyes pas/ /mnyam rdzogs byang chub sems kyi klong*/ /mya ngan gzhi med stong pa'i ngang*/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /rig stong gdod nas rnam dag pas/ /thams cad zab mo chos nyid klong*/ /mya ngan gzhi med stong ba'i ngang*/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /chos dbyings mkha' ltar stong gsal ngang*/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa'i klong*/ /yid mi bde ba mtha' grol ngang*/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /sems nyid gnyug ma khyab brdal bas/ /'od gsal rang byung ye shes klong*/ /zug rngu gzhi bral chos nyid ngang*/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /mya ngan sems kyis bzos pa yin/ /sdug bsngal blo yis btags pa yin/ /zug rngu rang gis byas pa yin/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /mi dgar 'dzin pa rang gis sems/ /de la kha dog dngos po med/ /ltos dang stong gsal nam mkha' 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /khro bar 'dzin pa rang gis sems/ /dpyad na gzhi rtsa dngos po med/

/ltos dang mkha' la rlangs yal 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /yid chad yid 'byung rang gi sems/ /gzhig na ye stong dngos po med/ /ltos dang bar snang stong pa 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /skyo bar 'dzin pa rang gi sems/ /brtags na yul med stong pa nyid/ /ltos dang nam mkha' rnam dag 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /'jigs par 'dzin pa rang gis sems/ /btsal na mi rnyed phyogs na med/ /ltos dang mkha' la sprin dengs 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /mtho dman re dogs rang gis sems/ /byung ba'i dus na don med la/ /ltos dang bar snang 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /legs nyes bde sdug rang gis sems/ /snang ba'i dus na rang bzhin med/ /ltos dang mkha' la tshe gzugs 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /'gyod cing gdung ba rang gis sems/ /phyi nang bar med ngos bzung bral/ /ltos dang nam mkha' yangs pa 'dra/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /gnas lugs gzhi med du bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// // yang cig ltos dang rig pa'i ngang*/ /gang ltar shar yang gdod ma'i dbyings/ /gnas lugs don gyi gsal 'debs yin/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /dgag sgrub gnyis kyi gsal 'debs yin/ /de ka'i ngang la tshur ltos dang*/ /shar grol rjen par zang thal le/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /bde sdug rig pa'i gsal 'debs yin/ /de ka'i ngang la tshur ltos dang*/ /rang gsal gdod mar rjen khres se/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /rkyen ngan chos nyid gsal 'debs yin/ /de ka'i ngang la tshur ltos dang*/ /chos zad gdod mar stong sang nge/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /bar chad gegs sar gsal 'debs yin/ /de ka'i ngang la tshur ltos dang*/ /'khu 'khrig rang grol gdeng ye re/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /gsal 'debs bogs 'byin du bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //

yang cig ltos dang gdod ma'i ngang*/ /thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal sku bzhi'i ngang*/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /mya ngan sems la tshur ltos dang*/ /gzhi med ye grol chos zad ngang*/ /stong gsal chos skur dga' yal le/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /sdug bsngal sems la tshur ltos dang*/ /rten med rtsa bral rang sangs ngang*/ /ma 'gags longs skur dga' yal le/ /mi dga' zug rngu'i sems la tshur ltos dang*/ /dngos med ye grol rang grol ngang*/ /rang grol sprul skur dga' yal le/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /mi dga'i sems la tshur ltos dang*/ /gnas med ye stong rtsa bral ngang*/ /ngo bo nyid skur dga' yal le/ /mi dga'i bya ba'i ming yang med/ /glu 'di ngo sprod gsal 'debs yin/ /gu yang yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob par shog /sku bzhi'i ngo sprod du bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// // mya ngan gzhi grol rdo rje'i glu/ rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa dge'o/ /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ /'khor ba ye nas ma grub pas/ /mya ngan gzhi nas yod ma myong*/ /mi dga' bya ba'i ming yang med/ /chos nyid ngang du dga' yal le/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / ༈ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ chos rje bla ma nyid lhun grub gling na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ skal ldan rnams la bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi mgur 'di gsungs so/ /rang don chos sku 'gyur med ngang*/ /gzhan don gzugs sku'i don mdzad pa/ / kun bzang chos rje bla ma dang*/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rig pa'i ngang la bar do med/ /ngang la mi 'gag med bzhin snang*/ /mkha' la 'byung bzhi'i 'pho 'gyur bzhin/ /bar do 'phrang sgrol glu 'di nyon/ /rig pa ka dag chos sku la/ /bar do bya ba yod ma myong*/ /bar do 'khor 'das rang snang yin/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /skye shi rmi lam 'chi kha

dang*/ /srid pa 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang ste/ /ting 'dzin chos nyid mya ngan 'das/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /bar do bya ba rang snang yin/ /rang snang gzhi med stong pa yin/ /stong gsal rig pa'i don la sbyong*/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /da lta'i lus sems snang ba 'di/ /skye shi bar do'i rang snang yin/ /gzhi med stong pa'i rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /rlung sems nang 'dus 'khrul snang gnyid/ /rmi lam bar do'i rang snang yin/ /rmi lam 'od gsal rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /bde gsal mi rtog bsam gtan 'di/ /ting 'dzin bar do'i rang snang yin/ /rang gnas ngang dwangs rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /phra rags 'byung ba'i thim tshul 'di/ /'chi kha bar do'i rang snang yin/ /ma yengs gsal 'debs rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /sku dang ye shes 'char tshul 'di/ /chos nyid bar do'i rang snang yin/ /rang ngo shes pa'i rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /skye 'chi gnyis kyi 'khrul snang 'di/ /srid pa bar do'i rang snang yin/ /dbang po gsum gyi rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /bar do'i 'char tshul snang ba kun/ /rang bzhin med pa gsal snang tsam/ /gzhi med stong pa'i rtsal sbyong mdzod/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /'khrul snang zhen pa rang dag na/ /skye shi bar do 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /chos dbyings ngo bo nyid skur grol/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /gnyid dang rmi lam 'od gsal 'dres/ /rmi lam bar do 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /mi rtog chos kyi sku ru grol/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /dgongs pa bar dang mtshams med na/ /ting 'dzin bar do 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku ru grol/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /goms pa'i gdams ngag rang gsal na/

/'chi kha bar do 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /mngon par byang chub sku ru grol/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /rang snang 'od gsal rang ngo shes/ /chos nyid bar do 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru grol/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /rkyen snang thug phrad gdams pa dran/ /srid pa bar do 'byongs pa'i tshad/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ru grol/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /phyir snang bar do'i dbyings su thim/ /dbyings nyid chos sku rang gsal ngang*/ /mthar thug 'bras bu thob pa lags/ /bar do'i 'phrang las grol ba lags/ /'khor 'das bar do'i 'phrang grol glu/ /gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge bas ma lus 'gro ba kun/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su grol bar shog/bar do 'phrang grol rdo rje'i glu/ rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa'o/ /chos rje bla ma rin po che/ /bar do'i 'phrang 'di 'jigs pa che/ /bar do'i 'phrang sgrol gdams pa zhu/ /bar do grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / ༈ rgyal sras chos rje bla ma nyid lhun grub gling na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ /rang gzhan gyi snang ba la thugs skyo zhing*/ sbas yul bgrod pa'i lo dang rtags mtshan mang po 'dzom par dgongs te/ skal ldan rnams la sbas yul bgrod pa'i rdo rje glu 'di gsungs so/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma badz+ra ye/ chos sku kun bzang longs sku 'od dpag med/ /rang byung sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'du 'bral med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /deng sang dus ngan lnga brgya tha ma la/ /gang du bsams kyang yid 'byung skyo ba skye/ /bdag gis sems 'di nags ri'i khrod dga' bas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i glu 'di nyon/ /yul rnams kun kyang rang bzhin 'gyur ba la/ /mi rnams kun kyang lo res gshis 'gyur zhing*/ /phyogs rnams kun kyang dmag dang 'khrug long rgyas/

/sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /mi dbang rgyal bo'i khrims kyang 'jig tu nye/ /sdig spyod sog po rnams kyang yong du nye/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di yang nub tu nye/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /bdud rigs 'byung po yul gyi dbus su zhugs/ /mi rnams 'khrug cing nad mtshon mu ge dar/ /gcig gis gcig 'joms dkon mchog rten gsum 'jig/ sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /mi rnams bde skyid khrims gnyis gru chen zhig /btsun pa rnams kyang dmag khral 'u lags 'bab/ / grong yul gog cing sde dgon khyim pas 'dzin/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /dad ldan nyung zhing dge ba'i grol thung nub/ /chos byed dmod cing sdig can bkur ba ste/ /rgyal ba'i rten la bkur sti rim gro med/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /chos mdzad dam pa rnams ni sku tshe thung*/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i sgron me nub tu nye/ /sdom dang dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba nyung*/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /thams cad kun kyang ngo tsha khrel yod 'dor/ /rigs dang mi rigs don la dpyod pa med/ /sri zhu'i gnas la bkur sti rim gro med/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /sngon gyi dben gnas gtsug lag khang rnams gog /mchod pa med cing sdig can rnams kyis 'dzin/ /dkor rnams spyod cing mar 'gro'i las ngan sog /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /mtha' mi dbus lhung dbus rnams mtha' ru 'chug /mtha' dbus 'khrug cing sdug bsngal rngon skad 'don/ /phyogs rnams gang na'ang bde skyid skabs med pas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /dad ldan dge ba can rnams yid 'byung zhing*/ /dben par mos pas zab don snying po tshol/ /lhag par rang byung pad+ma'i chos la mos/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/

/phyogs bzhi sbas yul rin chen sgo bzhi yang*/ /dam pa 'ga' yis la la rnyed ces grags/ /thams cad deng sang rnyed pa'i dus min pas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /snying nas chos mdzad skye bo kun gyis kyang*/ /da lta phyin na rang bzhin thar bar gsungs/ /phyi nas dka' bas deng sang gshegs re ran/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /sbas yul du bgrod pa'i dus tshigs bstan pa dang*/ /las can rnams spyir bskul ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// // yang cig nyon dang sprang po gu yangs pa/ /rang dbang thob cing don chung ci la chags/ /gang la bsams kyang skyo bar ma mthong ngam/ /sbas yul rin chen gnas su phyin na legs/ /chags sdang 'du 'dzi'i rnam par g.yeng bas gzeng*/ /bdag 'dzin gnas kyis bdag la ci byar yod/ /ma byas rang 'khrungs brag ri'i khang bzang gnas/ /sbas yul sna 'phel/ /sgyu ma'i nor gyis bdag la ci byar yod/ /dri med 'phags pa'i nor bdun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /ngoms shing tshad med spyad cing sred pa 'phel/ /bza' btung longs spyod bdag la ci byar yod/ /dka' thub bcud len ngang gis 'grub pa'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /dar zab ras dang snam ther la sogs pa/ /mdzes sgeg gos kyis bdag la ci byar yod/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis grang ba skyob pa'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /gang la zhon nas phyogs rnams 'gro byed pa/ /rta sogs zhon pas bdag la ci byar yod/ /rang gi goms pas phyogs rnams bgrod pa'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /bslab na mi nyan rtag tu zag pa 'phel/ / don med 'khor gyis bdag la ci byar yod/ /gcig pur gu yangs chos la spyod pa'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /rnam g.yengs log sgrub zug rngu rgyun mi chad/ /bu slob grwa bas bdag la ci byar yod/

/sus kyang mi 'ching rang dbang bde dal gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /rtag tu ngo srung sems 'dzin rgyun mi chad/ /sa gnas yon bdag bdag la ci byar yod/ /gang dang ma 'brel gnyen sgrub 'ching ba med/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /bstod pas tshe ring nad med chos 'phel lam/ /snyan dang grags pas bdag la ci byar yod/ /sus kyang mi thos dgag sgrub med pa'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /zol med phan pa sgrub kyang sgro skur gzhi/ /dus ngan gzhan don bdag la ci byar yod/ /rtag tu rang don zhi ba sgrub pa'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /'khrul snang 'du 'dzi gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i chos/ /tshe 'dis snang bas bdag la ci byar yod/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu chos kyis 'da' ba'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /phyi nang gi rkyen la mngon par skyo ba dang*/ rang la dgos su bskul ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // yang cig sbas yul rin chen bsngags pa nyon/ /skyid cing nyams dga' lha yi yul lta bu/ /phyi rabs don du rin chen gter du sbas/ /sbas yul rin chen gnas su sgom du gshegs/ /ri mtho sa gtsang mtha' dmag gnod pa med/ /yul yang nyams dga' bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bkra shis yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la

babs/ /sman ljongs nags tshal gangs ri'i tshogs mang zhing*/ /yid 'ong bya dang ri dwags mang pos gang*/ /chu rgyun gtsang ma'i lhung sgra snyan par sgrog / sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /ri rtse nags kyi mthong rnams nyams dga' zhing*/ /sba dang 'khri shing 'od ma'i ra bas bskor/ /rma bya gar byed khu byug snyan par sgrog /brag ri'i phugs dang lo ma'i khang bzang dang*/ /smyug ma'i bsil khang dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ /shing lo'i mal stan 'jam zhing mdzes pas brgyan/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /ma rmos lo tog gro ma 'bru yis tshogs/ /shing bal reg na bde ba'i gos bzang gyon/ /sngo 'od shing 'bras mang po'i kha zas ldan/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /dbyar bzhin dgun yang me tog mdangs bkra ba/ /dus bzhir nags tshal sngo 'khrungs bsil drod snyoms/ /dngas la yid spro sems gtsang rig pa 'dzin/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /rang byung pad+mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /zab gter yon tan 'byor pas brgyan pa'i gnas/ /rgyal sras sprul pa mchog rnams 'byon pa'i gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'og min zhing khams o rgyan gnas mchog bzhin/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /las can dbang po rab rnams 'du ba'i gnas/ /nyams rtogs byin rlabs dpag tu med pa'i gnas/ /yon tan tshad med gaṅgā'i bye snyed gnas/ /sbas yul rin chen bgrod pa'i dus la babs/ /sbas yul rin chen sgo bzhir 'jug pa'i glu/ /snang ba gu yangs yan pa blo bdes blangs/ /dge ba de yis las can skye bo kun/ /sbas yul phyin nas dngos grub mchog rab thob/ /yul gyi bkod pa dang yon tan la bsngags pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /sbas yul rin chen ma zhes bya ba/

rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i glur gsungs pa dge'o// //sbas yul rin chen skyid kyi yul/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba'i yul/ /rnal 'byor nyid kyang sgom du 'gro/ /skal ldan rnams kyang sgom du gshegs/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o/ / ༈ dgongs pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i chos rje bla ma nyid lhun grub gling na bzhugs pa'i dus/ skal ldan rnams la 'khor ba dong sprugs rdo rje'i glu 'di gsungs pa/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ mgon po gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / 'khor 'das kun gyi dpal gyur pa/ /kun bzang bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'khor ba dong sprugs dgongs pa nyon/ /chos kun ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i ming yang med/ /cir snang rang byung ye shes klong*/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /snod du snang ba gzhal yas khang*/ /bcud du snang ba lha yi sku/ /rtog tshogs rang grol chos nyid klong*/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /phung po rgyal ba yab lnga la/ / 'byung lnga rigs kyi yum du shar/ /dbang po khams rnams byang chub sems/ / 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /dkyil 'khor kun tu bzang po'i zhing*/ /ye nas mngon par sangs rgyas pas/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /sgo gsum gzugs sgra dran rig kun/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du sangs rgyas pas/ /ye nas bskyed rdzogs byang chub klong*/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /thams cad rang byung ye shes klong*/ /chos kun mnyam rdzogs chen po las/ /gzhan du cung zad g.yos pa med/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /bskyed par snang ba'i dus nyid nas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim par lhun grub pas/ /ye nas zung 'jug gnyis med ngang*/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i rang bzhin du/ /chos kun ka dag lhun grub pas/ /rgyu 'bras spang blang bya rtsol bral/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/

/phyi ltar snang yang yul med la/ /med pa gsal snang stong pa'i gzugs/ /thams cad rang byung ye shes ngang*/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /nang ltar snang yang sems med la/ /tshogs brgyad kun gzhi sgro btags tsam/ /thams cad blo bral chos dbyings ngang*/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /bar med rig pa zang thal le/ /yul sems rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /phyal ba rjen pa phyam brdal ngang*/ / 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /chos kun myang 'das ye zin pas/ /bya dang rtsol ba'i nad dang bral/ /bar med ngang du rjen khres se/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /ma bgrod ye nas nye ba'i lam/ /lam 'dir rang chas lhun grub pas/ /gzhan du mi bgrod gzhi phyam me/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /rig pa gcer bu zang ka ma/ /'khor 'das gnyis med gdod ma'i ngang*/ /spang gnyen med par zang thal le/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /rang gshis rig stong rjen pa la/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras ming med pas/ /dmigs gtad med par rgya khrol le/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /'gyur med rang rig rdzogs chen klong*/ /'khor ba ma spang ka nas dag /myang 'das ma btsal lhun gyis grub/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /rig pa ji bzhin g.yo med la/ /ched du ma btsal ma bsgrubs bzhin/ /yon tan 'char sgo dpag tu med/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /gang zhig cung zad ma spangs bar/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs rang sar dag /rig pa dri med shes sgong bzhin/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /yid la cung zad ma byas par/ /'gyur med rtogs pa'i gding tshad rnyed/ /nyams rtogs yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /brjod du med pa'i rig pa la/ /bsam dang bral ba'i gdod mar phyin/ /dmigs gtad bral bas gol sgrib chod/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /rang gsal ka nas dag pa'i ngang*/ /lhun grub 'char tshul dpag tu med/

/mthar thug chos kun zad sar phyin/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /rig stong bar med rang gsal la/ /phyi nang yul sems 'dzin pa zad/ /chos sku rang mal blo las 'das/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /chos 'di rdzogs pa chen po'i rtse/ /gang dang phrad rnams grol ba rnyed/ /srid pa tha ma'i dam chos lags/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /tshul 'di rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lus 'di tha mal cir yang snang*/ /dgongs pa chos nyid sangs rgyas dngos/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /glu 'di kun bzang chos sku'i glu/ /tshig 'di mi 'gyur rdo rje'i tshig /bro 'di gnas lugs rig pa'i bro/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /khams gsum ye nas grol ba'i glu/ /srid gsum ka nas dag pa'i tshig /rgyu 'bras bya rtsol bral ba'i bro/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /bla ma yi dam mnyes pa'i glu/ /mkha' 'gro dam can chags pa'i tshig /byin rlabs nyams rtogs 'bar ba'i bro/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa lags/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur rdo rje'i glu/ /klong chen rab 'byams bzang pos bkod/ /dge bas khams gsum yongs grol te/ /'khor ba dong nas sprugs par shog /'khor ba dong sprugs rdo rje'i glu/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa'o// // glu 'di khams gsum yongs grol glu/ /tshig 'di srid gsum ka dag tshig /bro 'dis byin rlabs nyams rtogs 'bar/ /'khor ba dong sprugs chen po lags/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / yang chos rje bla mas lhun grub gling du skal ldan rnams la bkra shis rdo rje'i glu 'di gsungs so/ /a ho/ bkra shis dpal du 'bar ba'i lha/ /mchog gsum bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bkra shis rin chen char 'bebs pa'i/ / phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /gnas 'di gang snang sangs rgyas zhing*/ /rang snang rig pa'i zhing khams la/ /ye nas 'og min chos kyi dbyings/

/gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /mgon 'di chos rje rin po che/ /'gro ba 'dre pa'i dpal du shar/ /ye nas rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul mgon/ /ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /'khor 'di skal ldan dad dang ldan/ /thar lam sgrub pa snying por byed/ /ye nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /chos 'di theg pa kun gyi rtse/ /mchog tu gsang ba bla na med/ /ye nas rdzogs pa chen po'i klong*/ /chos phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /dus 'di chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med/ /rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo'i gzhi/ /ye nas dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid/ /dus phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis mi 'gyur rdo rje'i glu/ /bkra shis gu yangs blo bdes blangs/ /bkra shis yid bzhin mchod sdong la/ /bkra shis dpal du 'bar bar shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar ma zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis gsungs pa dge'o/ /gcig gnyis gsum byas nas/ /bkra shis dpal du 'bar ba lags/ /gnyis gsum drug byas nas/ /bkra shis bsam pa 'grub pa lags/ /dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza la rtogs pa phul ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ / oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i chos nyid las/ /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor ma 'dres gsal/ /thugs rje'i sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma grogs dag phyogs 'dzin sems bor la/ /gzu bo'i yid kyis rtogs pa'i don 'di nyon/ /bdag dang sna tshogs srid pa'i sems can rnams/ /ye nas rnam dag sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /rig dang ma rig zhes bya'i tha snyad kyis/ /srid par 'khrul pa rmi lam sgyu ma tsam/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul gnyis med rgyal ba'i sku/ /da lta nyid nas sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /lhun grub rtsal la lus dang yul 'khrul zhing*/ /ye shes rtsal las ma rig sems 'khrul yang*/

/ma rig sems nyid rig pa'i ye shes dngos/ / spang blang 'khrul pa'i byung khungs zad pa yin/ /gzhi med rtsa bral 'gyu ba ye shes che/ /sangs rgyas sems nyid ma bcos zang ka ma/ /gza' gtad blang dor tha snyad kun las 'das/ /bkag pas mi khegs de bzhin sgrub tu med/ / rang shar rang grol skyes grol snga phyi med/ /dge med sdig bral gzung 'dzin kun las 'das/ / gang yin yin gyi gnyen pos bcos mi dgos/ /'di yin med kyi spang byar bskyur du med/ /gzung bas ma bslad 'dzin pas ma bsgribs shing*/ /byar med ngang la lhun grub blo bde'o/ /bdag blo'i mkha' la rtogs pa'i nyi ma shar/ /mi nub stong khams brdal ba yongs la khyab/ / phyogs med ris bral dus bzhir 'gyur ba med/ /rang gis mthong ste bshad kyang mtshon du med/ /nyi ma'i snying po ye shes rig pa'i rtsal/ /gang ltar shar yang de ltar mi 'dzin pa/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ched du bsgom pa med/ /'khrul pa zhig pas sgrib pa ma mthong ste/ /gang ltar shar yang kun bzang dag pa'i klong*/ /yengs dang ma yengs bdag la rtsis gdab med/ /sgom dang mi sgom lta dang spyod pa med/ /don 'di yin min su la'ang dri rgyu med/ /yod min med min sems kyis btags pa'i chos/ /rtog pas gzir rnams ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kyang*/ /rang bzhin gzhan yin ye yin rdzogs pa che/ /ye shes mdangs yin zhing khams chen po yin/ /de ltar yin yang skal ba dman pa'i blos/ /'bring dang tha ma'i gang zag drang ba'i phyir/ /yengs med dran pa'i lta sgom mdzad pa yang*/ /ngo mtshar che ste bdag blo'i yid ma khengs/ /rang rig rdzogs chen bya rtsol med pa'i don/ /dge sdig phan gnod med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i sprin gyis sgrib ci dgos/ /blo yis bltar med sems kyis bsgom du med/ / sngar yang 'bad rtsol zhen pa'i chos rnams kyis/

/'khor ba 'dir 'khyams sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig byas/ /da ni rtsol med rang grol skad cig ma/ /skyes dang grol mnyam dge sdig de ltar rtogs/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs rang sar rang gis grol/ /skad cig sems ni kha dog dbyibs med na/ /de la brten pa'i chos rnams soms dang kye/ /dran rig sems 'di rang grol chos kyi sku/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i ngang las 'bros par mthong*/ /de tshe sems kyang rang bzhin 'khrul pa ste/ /blang dor mi dgos rig pa'i mtshang 'di rtogs/ / rtogs pa'i don la rgyun chad med pa'i blo/ /gnyis ka rnam dag chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnas/ /mthar thug snying po'i don nyid thob nas kyang*/ /rtsol bcas sems kyis bsgrub pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod/ /rin chen rnyed nas 'ching bu tshol ba bzhin/ /kyi hud bskal par 'bad kyang grol par gyur pa dkon/ /skal bzang 'od gsal ye shes snying po'i don/ /kun la yod kyang kun gyis mi rtogs te/ /nye bar gyur kyang ma mthong dmus long bzhin/ /kye ma bdag ni drin chen bla ma'i drin/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis bkye bas rdzogs par nyon/ /ye nas rang gnas ka dag lhun grub ste/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i snying po can/ /sangs rgyas sems can rgya chad phyogs lhung med/ /kun gyi spyi gzhi 'od gsal chen por gnas/ /de nyid ngang las lhun grub gdangs shar bas/ / thugs rje rig pa'i rtsal g.yos skad cig la/ /rig pa kun bzang gzhi thog byang chub ste/ /ma rig 'khrul yang bdag dang sems can kun/ /snying dbus gzhon nu bum pa'i skur gsal ba/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum du gnas/ /ngo bo mi rtog 'di zhes mtshon du med/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rin chen mdangs lnga'i 'od/ /dar dkar rtsa la rgya mtshor tshang bcas te/ /dag pa'i mkha' la zer gdangs so sor gsal/ /'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings rig dgongs pa la/ /gzung 'dzin med pa'i dmigs pa'i lcags kyu ste/

/ 'od gsal nyid la rang sems goms pa yis/ /lus dang yul grol 'khrul snang longs skur thim/ /'dzin bcas rtog pa snang ba rang nub nas/ /longs sku'i snang ba ka dag ngang du thim/ /bum pa'i sku de rang gsal lhun gyis grub/ /rnam mkhyen thams cad mkhyen par thim pa yis/ /kun mkhyen ye shes sku gsum 'du 'bral med/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i zhing na lhang nge ba/ /rtag min chad min rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /mi g.yo mi gsung chos sku'i ngang la bzhugs/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten mkhyen nas 'od 'gyed de/ /chos sku'i ngang las longs sku'i snang ba 'di/ /rig pa sku lnga ye shes lnga la sogs/ /shel las 'od bzhin longs sku'i zhing snang ngo*/ /de las snod bcud sprul pa'i rang bzhin sku/ /sna tshogs der ston gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin/ /gang 'dul der snang gcig char rnam par sprul/ /gdul bya'i 'khor ba ma lus rab drangs nas/ /sprul sku longs sku bum pa'i skur thim nas/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin ka dag chen po'i ngang*/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub par bzhugs pa yin/ /de ltar rang snang rtogs pa'i don smras kyang*/ /skal med rnams la log lta'i sprin 'khrigs te/ /tshig ngan char gyis phyogs rnams kun tu khyab/ /kye ma gcig pur gnas rnams spro ba rab tu skye/ /rang gnas rtogs pa'i 'od gsal nyi shar yang*/ /blo ngan mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'thoms te/ /lhun grub chos sku'i gzugs mdzes ma mthong bas/ /ma rig sdug bsngal nyon mongs nyam thag gis/ /blo dang thos pa'i nor gyis legs 'byor cing*/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i 'dabs gshog rab rdzogs kyang*/ /dman pa'i 'gro la gcig pu'i ri dwags bzhin/ /ji ltar bdag gis nam zhig phan thogs 'gyur/ / rin chen gsang ba'i yang gab ces bya ba g.ya' phu'i mig ces bya ba'i dben gnas su bla ma dam pa ku ma rā dza bzhugs pa'i drung du phyin dus der brtson gyi bstan 'dzin khregs chod bsgoms pa la/

dgongs pa chu bo'i rgyun 'di bdag gis yi ger bkod nas phul bas/ bla ma rin po che shin tu mnyes nas 'or che 'or che pha la bu skyes gsungs nas bsngags te/ yi ge 'di bla med thob pa ma gtogs pa gzhan la ma bstan cig gsungs nas bka' rgya mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ spros pa'i yul las 'das/ rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad med/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ 'khor 'das gnyis su med/ gnyis 'dzin 'khrul par shes na de kas chogaskad cig ma'i mtshang rig pa'i gdams ngag sangs rgyas lag 'chang zhes bya ba 'di/ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi spyod yul thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /
